items.title: 立訊精密回應美337調查：涉案產品尚處客戶驗證階段 不影響營運
items.title_en: Luxshare Precision Responds to US 337 Investigation: Product Under Investigation Still in Customer Validation Phase, No Impact on Operations
paras: 立訊精密(02475-HK) 周六(10日)晚間應美國337調查，表示涉案產品目前仍處於客戶驗證階段，尚未進入量產，預期不會對現階段生產營運及當期經營績效造成重大不利影響；公司已啟動相關專利與產品研究，將積極應訴。
美國國際貿易委員會（USITC）當地時間9日宣布，應電源技術業者維克爾（Vicor Corporation）提出的專利侵權主張，正式啟動337調查，調查編號為337-TA-1526。
本案涉及美國專利US 10,903,734，調查範圍包括垂直供電系統（VPD）、相關組件，以及包含上述產品的計算系統，立訊精密與立訊技術均列入被調查方。
337調查是USITC依據美國《1930年關稅法》第337條進行的程序，主要針對進口產品涉及的專利、商標等智慧財產權侵權行為。若ITC最終認定侵權成立，可發布有限排除令或禁制令。
不過，本案目前仍在立案初期，USITC尚未對侵權主張作出實質認定。立訊精密公告指出，根據USITC公開資訊，Vicor先前曾多次針對資料中心電源相關技術，向產業鏈企業提出337調查。
根據公開文件，本案被調查方還包括台達電(2308-TW) 、英飛凌，以及鴻海(2317-TW) 、廣達(2382-TW) 等企業。立訊精密初步評估，涉案產品主要應用於資料中心，是電源模組與處理器的整合供電方案；目前產品仍在客戶驗證階段，尚未量產，因此公司預期調查不會對現階段生產經營及當期業績造成重大不利影響。
立訊精密表示，公司已第一時間啟動涉案專利及相關產品研究，並組成技術、法律與業務團隊，參考先前相關案件的因應經驗，制定策略與工作計畫。後續將積極應訴，持續進行專利技術分析、產品方案評估及必要的技術最佳化，並加強與客戶及供應鏈夥伴溝通，以推動相關業務有序進行。
立訊精密也表示，公司堅持自主創新、尊重智慧財產權，對自身技術研發能力及長期發展保持信心。公司提醒，本案裁決結果仍有不確定性，將持續評估對經營可能造成的影響，並及時履行資訊揭露義務。
立訊精密今年8月在業績說明會上表示，正布局銅連接、光連接、電源與熱管理等領域，推進AI算力基礎設施相關業務，並與主要客戶合作開發近芯供電、近芯散熱、銅光互連及晶片封裝整合等方案。此次調查涉及的資料中心供電產品，仍處於客戶驗證階段。
paras_en: Luxshare Precision (02475-HK) responded on Saturday night (the 10th) to the US 337 investigation, stating that the product involved is still in the customer validation stage and has not entered mass production, and it is expected that this will not have a material adverse effect on current production operations or the period’s performance; the company has launched related patent and product research and will actively defend the case.

The US International Trade Commission (USITC) announced on the 9th local time that, following a patent infringement claim by power‑technology company Vicor Corporation, it has formally initiated a 337 investigation, case number 337‑TA‑1526.

The case involves US Patent No. 10,903,734, and the investigation scope includes vertical power delivery (VPD) systems, related components, and computing systems that incorporate the aforementioned products; both Luxshare Precision and Luxshare Technology are listed as respondents.

A 337 investigation is a procedure conducted by the USITC under Section 337 of the Tariff Act of 1930, primarily targeting alleged infringement of patents, trademarks and other IP rights in imported goods. If the ITC ultimately finds infringement, it may issue a limited exclusion order or a cease‑and‑desist order.

However, the case is still in its early filing stage and the USITC has not yet made a substantive finding on the infringement claim. Luxshare Precision noted that, according to publicly available USITC information, Vicor has previously filed multiple 337 investigations against companies in the data‑center power‑supply chain.

Public documents show that other respondents in the case include Delta Electronics (2308‑TW), Infineon, as well as Foxconn (2317‑TW) and Quanta (2382‑TW). Luxshare Precision’s preliminary assessment is that the product in question is mainly used in data centers as an integrated power‑module‑and‑processor delivery solution; the product is still in customer validation and not yet in mass production, so the company expects the investigation will not materially affect current production or the period’s results.

Luxshare Precision said it immediately launched research on the implicated patents and related products, forming technical, legal and business teams, drawing on experience from prior similar cases to devise strategies and work plans. It will actively defend the case, continue patent‑technology analysis, product‑solution evaluation and necessary technical optimisation, and strengthen communication with customers and supply‑chain partners to ensure orderly business progress.

Luxshare Precision also affirmed its commitment to independent innovation and respect for intellectual‑property rights, expressing confidence in its own R&D capabilities and long‑term development. The company cautioned that the outcome of the case remains uncertain, will keep assessing any potential impact on operations, and will fulfil disclosure obligations in a timely manner.

At its August earnings briefing, Luxshare Precision said it is building capabilities in copper interconnects, optical interconnects, power and thermal management, advancing AI‑compute infrastructure business, and collaborating with major customers on near‑chip power, near‑chip cooling, copper‑optical interconnects and chip‑package integration solutions. The data‑center power products involved in this investigation are still in the customer validation stage.

items.title: 中國原油進口回溫？96艘超級油輪將抵港、創2月底以來新高
items.title_en: China's Crude Oil Imports Warm Up? 96 Super Tankers Set to Arrive, Highest Since End‑February
paras: 中國原油進口動向出現回溫訊號。根據《彭博》彙整的油輪追蹤數據，截至10月10日，預計未來90天內將有約96艘超級油輪抵達中國，創今年2月底以來最高紀錄，且相關數據已連續3週上升。不過，中國原油採購是否已全面恢復，仍有待觀察。
美伊衝突爆發初期，全球最大原油進口國中國大幅削減原油採購。當時，連接波斯灣與國際市場的重要航道荷姆茲海峽實際上陷入封鎖，嚴重干擾全球原油運輸。
如今，駛往中國的超級油輪數量持續增加，成為市場觀察中國原油需求變化的重要指標。
不過，油輪數量回升尚不代表中國原油採購已全面恢復。數據顯示，去年同期駛往中國的超級油輪達111艘，高於目前的96艘。中國原油需求能否完全復甦，抑或如部分分析師預期，在年底前持續低迷，目前仍未明朗。
儘管針對過往船隻的攻擊事件仍持續發生，近幾週荷姆茲海峽的原油運輸量已回升至接近戰前水準，為中國恢復大規模原油採購提供物流條件。
自美伊衝突爆發以來，交易員持續關注中國的原油採購規模。由於中國在全球原油市場占有重要地位，若需求持續回升，可能對國際油價產生實質影響。
目前，駛往中國的超級油輪數量及後續變化，仍是市場評估全球原油供需走勢的重要觀察指標。
paras_en: China's crude oil import trend shows signs of warming. According to Bloomberg's compiled tanker tracking data, as of October 10 about 96 super‑tankers are expected to arrive in China over the next 90 days, a record high since the end of February, and the figures have risen for three consecutive weeks. However, whether China's crude purchases have fully recovered remains to be seen.

In the early stage of the US‑Iran conflict, China, the world's largest crude importer, sharply cut its oil purchases. At that time the strategic Hormuz Strait, a key conduit between the Persian Gulf and international markets, was effectively blocked, severely disrupting global crude shipments.
Now the number of super‑tankers heading to China continues to rise, becoming an important gauge for the market to monitor changes in China's crude demand.

Nevertheless, the rebound in tanker numbers does not mean that China's crude buying has fully resumed. Data show that in the same period last year, 111 super‑tankers sailed to China, higher than the current 96. It is still unclear whether Chinese crude demand will fully recover or, as some analysts expect, stay weak through year‑end.

Despite ongoing attacks on vessels, crude flows through the Hormuz Strait have risen in recent weeks to near pre‑conflict levels, providing the logistical conditions for China to resume large‑scale crude purchases.

Since the outbreak of the US‑Iran conflict, traders have closely watched the scale of China's crude procurement. Because China holds a pivotal role in the global oil market, a sustained demand rebound could have a material impact on international oil prices.
The current volume of super‑tankers heading to China and its subsequent changes remain a key indicator for the market in assessing global crude supply‑and‑demand dynamics.

items.title: 大盤創高後拉回 這12檔台股ETF規模仍創高 00927今年來漲幅翻倍居冠
items.title_en: Market Hits Highs Then Pulls Back, Yet 12 Taiwan Stock ETFs Still Reach Record Sizes; 00927 Doubles Gains This Year
paras: 大盤創高後拉回整理，但仍有台股ETF規模逆勢創高，根據CMONEY統計資料顯示，包括群益半導體收益(00927-TW)、國泰永續高股息(00878-TW)、元大高股息(0056-TW)在內有12檔規模創新高，其中以市值、高息型為主。進一步觀察這12檔今年以來含息績效表現，以群益 00927 上漲107.36%翻倍的績效居冠。
據了解，00927 群益半導體收益ETF每1、4、7、10月配息，成分股皆為享譽全球的半導體供應鏈大廠，整體持股布局橫跨IC設計、晶圓代工與製造、封裝測試等領域，完整涵蓋半導體產業生態系，主要集中在先進製程與成熟代工(台積電、聯電、日月光)，同時搭配傳統高息股(如瑞昱)，兼具半導體與高息兩大市場火熱主題，有助投資人把握半導體產業成長行情，還能兼顧收益需求。
群益投信台股研究團隊表示，國人熱愛台股ETF是因為其波動度相對個股與大盤來的低，現階段大盤頻創新高下，接下來面臨的挑戰更為複雜，台股類股輪動快速、個股波動性大，預期台股指數傾向高檔震盪，建議投資人可以透過高股息ETF來為投組增加抗震力，其中結合半導體科技產業成長前景的高股息ETF除了具低波動特性、可兼顧收益需求，還有AI熱潮所帶來的潛在資本利得可期，因此成為現階段資金配置的最佳選擇。

群益半導體收益 ETF 經理人謝明志表示，台股高股息ETF的特性偏向高配息兼具成長性的股票，涵蓋全產業配置能兼顧多元產業紅利，而台灣半導體8月營收年增61%大幅優於歷史平均，第三季在AI先進製程與高階封測驅動下，晶圓代工與封測營收預估季增15%至20%。第四季受惠旺季動能延續，族群營收料維持雙位數季增。台灣作為AI產業關鍵供應鏈，不論是先進代工、封裝等半導體電子產業相關供應鏈營運有望持續受惠，台股盤勢仍有望迎接第四季傳統股市旺季上漲契機。

paras_en: After the market hit new highs and then retreated for a pull‑back, Taiwan stock ETFs continued to grow against the trend. According to CMONEY data, twelve ETFs—including Qunyi Semiconductor Yield (00927‑TW), Cathay Sustainable High Dividend (00878‑TW) and Yuanta High Dividend (0056‑TW)—set new record assets, mainly large‑cap and high‑yield funds. Looking at their total‑return performance since the start of the year, Qunyi’s 00927 led with a 107.36% rise, effectively doubling its value.

The 00927 Qunyi Semiconductor Yield ETF distributes dividends in January, April, July and October. Its holdings consist of globally renowned semiconductor supply‑chain giants, spanning IC design, wafer foundry, manufacturing and packaging/testing, covering the entire semiconductor ecosystem. The portfolio focuses on advanced and mature fabs such as TSMC, UMC and ASE, while also including traditional high‑yield stocks like Realtek, blending semiconductor growth with high‑dividend themes to let investors capture industry expansion while meeting income needs.

Qunyi Asset Management’s Taiwan equity research team notes that Taiwanese investors favor stock ETFs because they are less volatile than individual stocks or the broader market. With the index repeatedly hitting fresh highs, future challenges become more complex: sector rotation is rapid and single‑stock volatility is high, so the index is expected to trade in a high‑range consolidation. They recommend high‑dividend ETFs to add resilience to portfolios, especially those that combine semiconductor growth prospects. Such ETFs offer low volatility, steady income and potential capital gains from the AI boom, making them an optimal choice for current fund allocation.

ETF manager Hsieh Ming‑Chih of Qunyi Semiconductor Yield explains that Taiwan’s high‑dividend ETFs tend to feature high payouts together with growth potential, covering a broad range of industries to capture diverse sector dividends. Taiwan’s semiconductor revenue jumped 61% year‑over‑year in August, far above historical averages. In Q3, driven by AI‑related advanced processes and high‑end packaging, wafer‑foundry and packaging revenues are projected to grow 15‑20% quarter‑over‑quarter. Q4 is expected to benefit from seasonal momentum, with the sector likely posting double‑digit quarterly growth. As a key AI supply‑chain hub, Taiwan’s advanced fabs and packaging firms should continue to thrive, keeping the market poised for a traditional fourth‑quarter rally.

items.title: 看好開放模型！輝達洽談加碼投資Reflection AI、提供算力
items.title_en: Optimistic About Open-Weight Models! Nvidia Talks to Increase Investment in Reflection AI, Provide Compute
paras: 彭博引述消息人士寶島，輝達(NVDA-US) 正與 Reflection AI 洽談，考慮增加對這家新創公司的投資，或提供算力，以深化與這家開放權重模型重要開發商的合作關係。
消息人士指出，洽談仍處於初步階段，雙方尚未達成任何條件。
《金融時報》先前報導，相關洽談可能促成收購提議。可能的交易方式包括「人才收購」，也就是輝達聘用 Reflection 的員工並取得技術授權；提供更多晶片給這家新創公司；或提高輝達的持股投資。
Reflection 本月稍早推出首款開放權重模型 Beam，進軍中國新創公司占有一席之地的市場。開放權重模型會公開模型參數，也就是權重，讓其他人能免費使用並修改相關技術。
Reflection 表示，Beam 的設計目標是以低於許多競爭產品的成本，在程式編寫和 AI 代理任務上為企業客戶與開發者提供良好表現。
該公司指出，Beam 在進階推理基準測試中的成績與中國智譜 AI（Z.AI）的旗艦開放模型 GLM-5.2 相當。
Reflection 由兩名前 Google DeepMind 研究人員創立。《華爾街日報》先前報導，該公司曾洽談募資 25 億美元，估值達 250 億美元。
Reflection 也與馬斯克旗下的 SpaceX(SPCX-US) 及雲端服務業者 Nebius Group NV 簽下數十億美元合約，以取得開發模型所需的算力。
若輝達與 Reflection 達成合作，將為這家晶片製造商近幾個月一連串交易再添一筆。身為全球市值最高的公司，輝達運用雄厚財力扶植更廣泛的 AI 產業。
相關交易包括今年 9 月以 130 億美元收購 AI 模型公司 Hugging Face，以及與晶片新創公司 Groq 簽署約 200 億美元的授權協議。
輝達執行長黃仁勳也是開放權重模型的主要支持者。美國發展這類技術，有望降低新創公司對中國開放權重模型的依賴。相較於 OpenAI 和 Anthropic PBC 等美國公司的模型，中國模型使用成本低得多，智能表現也沒有落後太多。
美國政府也在鼓勵此類模型的發展。
美國總統川普 2025 年 7 月提出的 AI 行動計畫指出：「我們必須確保美國擁有以美國價值觀為基礎的領先開放模型。開源與開放權重模型，可能在部分商業領域及全球學術研究中成為標準。」
paras_en: Bloomberg, citing sources on the island, reports that Nvidia (NVDA-US) is in talks with Reflection AI about potentially increasing its investment in the startup or providing compute power, deepening its partnership with the important open-weight model developer.
Sources say the discussions are still in early stages and no terms have been agreed upon yet.

The Financial Times previously reported that the talks could lead to an acquisition proposal. Possible deal structures include a "talent acquisition"—Nvidia hiring Reflection staff and licensing the technology—providing more chips to the startup, or increasing Nvidia's equity stake.

Reflection launched its first open-weight model, Beam, earlier this month, entering a market where Chinese startups have a foothold. Open-weight models publish their parameters, i.e., weights, so others can use and modify the technology for free.
Reflection says Beam is designed to deliver strong performance for enterprise customers and developers on coding and AI-agent tasks at a cost lower than many competing products.
The company notes that Beam’s results on advanced inference benchmark tests are comparable to Zhipu AI’s (Z.AI) flagship open model GLM‑5.2.
Reflection was founded by two former Google DeepMind researchers. The Wall Street Journal previously reported the company had been in talks to raise $2.5 billion at a $25 billion valuation.
Reflection has also signed multi‑billion‑dollar contracts with Elon Musk’s SpaceX (SPCX-US) and cloud provider Nebius Group NV to secure the compute needed to develop its models.

If Nvidia and Reflection reach a deal, it would add another transaction to a series of deals Nvidia has completed in recent months. As the world’s most valuable company, Nvidia is using its deep pockets to foster a broader AI ecosystem.
Related deals include the September‑2023 $13 billion acquisition of AI model company Hugging Face and a roughly $20 billion licensing agreement with chip startup Groq.

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is also a major advocate of open-weight models. Developing such technology in the United States could reduce startups’ reliance on Chinese open-weight models. Compared with U.S. models from OpenAI and Anthropic PBC, Chinese models are much cheaper to run and are not far behind in performance.
The U.S. government is also encouraging the development of these models.

President Trump’s AI Action Plan, proposed for July 2025, states: "We must ensure the United States has leading open models grounded in American values. Open‑source and open‑weight models may become the standard in certain commercial sectors and global academic research."

items.title: H-1B數據與范斯說法有落差？微軟多數核准者早已在職  亞馬遜、Meta人多卻未受限
items.title_en: H‑1B Data Contradicts Vance’s Claim? Most of Microsoft’s Approved Workers Were Already Employees; Amazon and Meta Have Many H‑1B Holders Yet Face No Restrictions
paras: 美國副總統范斯（JD Vance）指控，微軟(MSFT-US) 2025年裁撤6,000名員工後，改以持H-1B工作簽證的外籍勞工填補職缺。不過，美國公民及移民服務局（USCIS）的簽證核准數據顯示，微軟去年獲准的H-1B簽證中，約三分之二是給已在公司任職的員工，並非新聘人員。
根據《CNBC》報導，川普政府週四（8日）宣布，暫停8家科技公司透過勞工部PERM計畫為外籍員工申請綠卡的資格。
這項措施暫停的是美國勞工部的PERM綠卡申請計畫，該計畫涉及協助移民取得永久居留權的程序，並不影響H-1B臨時工作簽證。
不過，H-1B簽證核准數據仍能反映這些企業對外籍勞工的依賴程度。
值得注意的是，根據美國公民及移民服務局的H-1B雇主數據中心，亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 與Meta(META-US) 是2025財政年度獲准H-1B簽證最多的兩家企業，分別取得19,178件及6,294件核准，但兩家公司均未被列入暫停名單。微軟則以6,258件緊追在後。
范斯在週四的記者會上表示，微軟2025年裁撤6,000名員工，卻大量聘用持H-1B簽證的外籍勞工。
他聲稱：「如果算一下，每裁掉一名員工，微軟就以1.5名外籍契約勞工取代他們。」不過，范斯同時強調，微軟是一家優秀的美國企業，雙方維持良好關係。
然而，報導指出，簽證數據顯示，儘管微軟去年確實取得超過6,000件H-1B簽證核准，但其中約三分之二的受益人原本就已在微軟工作。
相較之下，亞馬遜去年取得的H-1B核准數量約為微軟的3倍，且新聘的H-1B員工人數接近微軟的4倍，但亞馬遜卻並未被列入暫停名單。
此次遭暫停PERM計畫申請資格的8家企業，全都名列美國H-1B簽證核准數量前50大雇主，其中多數為資訊科技服務及顧問公司，Adobe(ADBE-US) 則排名第45，是名單中規模最小的企業。
從整體排名來看，亞馬遜與Meta的H-1B簽證核准數量均高於微軟，卻未遭到同樣處置。微軟過去多年一直是H-1B簽證的主要雇主，但亞馬遜在2017年超越微軟後，兩者的差距持續擴大。
川普政府此次整頓行動不僅針對科技業。勞工部監察長德艾斯波西托（Anthony D’Esposito）同日在記者會上宣布，將調查9所美國知名大學涉嫌涉及J-1簽證詐欺的案件。
川普的支持者長期主張，企業透過相關簽證計畫聘用外國人，可能削弱美國勞工的就業機會。
paras_en: U.S. Vice President JD Vance accused Microsoft (MSFT‑US) of replacing 6,000 jobs slated for elimination in 2025 with foreign workers on H‑1B visas. However, data from U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) shows that about two‑thirds of the H‑1B visas Microsoft received approval for last year were granted to employees already working at the company, not to new hires.

According to a CNBC report, the Trump administration announced on Thursday (the 8th) that it would suspend eight technology companies from using the Department of Labor’s PERM program to apply for green cards for foreign employees.
The suspension applies to the Department of Labor’s PERM green‑card application program, which assists immigrants in obtaining permanent residency, and does not affect the temporary H‑1B work visa.
Nevertheless, H‑1B approval data still reflects how much these firms rely on foreign labor.

Notably, USCIS’s H‑1B employer data center shows that Amazon (AMZN‑US) and Meta (META‑US) were the two companies with the most H‑1B approvals for fiscal year 2025, receiving 19,178 and 6,294 approvals respectively, and neither was placed on the suspension list. Microsoft followed closely with 6,258 approvals.
Vance said at Thursday’s press conference that Microsoft will cut 6,000 jobs in 2025 but will hire a large number of foreign workers on H‑1B visas.

He claimed, “If you do the math, Microsoft replaces each laid‑off employee with 1.5 foreign contract workers.” He also emphasized that Microsoft is a great American company and that relations remain good.

However, the report notes that visa data shows that although Microsoft did receive more than 6,000 H‑1B approvals last year, roughly two‑thirds of the beneficiaries were already employed by Microsoft.

In contrast, Amazon’s H‑1B approvals last year were about three times Microsoft’s, and the number of newly hired H‑1B employees was nearly four times Microsoft’s, yet Amazon was not placed on the suspension list.

All eight firms whose PERM applications were suspended are among the top 50 U.S. H‑1B employers, most of them information‑technology services and consulting firms; Adobe (ADBE‑US) ranks 45th and is the smallest company on the list.

Overall, Amazon and Meta have higher H‑1B approval counts than Microsoft but were not treated the same. Microsoft has long been a major H‑1B employer, but after Amazon overtook it in 2017, the gap has continued to widen.

The Trump administration’s crackdown is not limited to the tech sector. Department of Labor Inspector General Anthony D’Esposito announced at the same press conference that investigations will be launched into nine well‑known U.S. universities suspected of J‑1 visa fraud.
Trump supporters have long argued that companies hiring foreigners through these visa programs may diminish employment opportunities for American workers.

items.title: 高檔震盪消化雜音 法人：台股Q4重回獲利驅動 資金輪動「這些」族群
items.title_en: High-Level Oscillation Sifts Out Noise; Institutions: Taiwan Stocks Return to Profit-Driven Q4; Capital Rotates into These Sectors
paras: 台股近期呈現高檔震盪整理格局，上攻 5 萬大關再等等。安聯投信台股團隊表示，近期全球金融市場持續受到美國利率政策、債券殖利率變動及地緣政治風險等因素干擾，市場波動加劇。不過，隨著消化相關不確定因素逐步被消化，第四季市場焦點有望重新回歸企業營收、獲利表現與產業基本面，台股也有機會由企業獲利驅動投資階段。
近期大型權值股走勢相對疲軟，被動元件族群逆勢吸引資金青睞。隨著AI伺服器及高效能運算帶動高階積層陶瓷電容(MLCC)與晶片電阻需求快速增加，加上消費性電子旺季備貨啟動及車用電子滲透率持續提升，高耐壓、高容值產品供需逐漸轉趨緊俏，市場再度浮現漲價題材。
安聯台灣大壩基金暨安聯台灣科技基金經理人蕭惠中表示，雖然美國長天期公債殖利率維持高檔，短期對科技股評價帶來壓力，但AI產業基本面依然穩健。從GPU、ASIC、高階應用處理器對先進製程及先進封裝需求持續提升，到北美雲端服務供應商(CSP)不斷上修資本支出計畫，都顯示AI投資循環仍維持高度成長階段。
安聯台灣智慧基金經理人陳思銘指出，短線市場焦點將聚焦資金流向、國際政經情勢與企業基本面表現，預期大盤將維持高檔震盪整理，資金則持續向具備實質業績成長題材的個股輪動。
在企業獲利方面，安聯投信預估台股企業獲利成長動能持續增強，2026年整體企業獲利年增率上修至84.07%，2027年可望再成長35.56%。其中，電子產業仍是主要成長引擎，2027年獲利成長率預估達45%，反映AI趨勢所帶來的結構性成長機會。
展望後市，安聯投信台股團隊看好AI相關供應鏈持續受惠於運算效能升級與規格提升趨勢，包括IP／ASIC、先進製程與封裝測試、PCB／CCL、ABF載板、散熱、水冷模組及光通訊等領域隨著新一代AI晶片及伺服器平台陸續推出，不僅可望帶動相關零組件需求成長，也將推升產業獲利與產品價值提升。
投資策略方面，安聯投信台股團隊表示，現階段仍以AI供應鏈為核心配置，聚焦具備市占率提升、滲透率增加、規格升級及產品組合優化等成長動能的企業，並結合2026至2028年的產業發展趨勢，持續發掘基本面具上修潛力的投資標的。
paras_en: Taiwan’s stock market has recently been in a high‑level oscillation and consolidation pattern, with the next push toward the 50,000‑point mark still pending. Allianz Asset Management’s Taiwan equity team said that global financial markets have been increasingly volatile due to U.S. interest‑rate policy, bond‑yield movements and geopolitical risks. However, as the related uncertainties are gradually digested, the focus in Q4 is expected to shift back to corporate revenue, earnings performance and industry fundamentals, giving Taiwan stocks a chance to be driven by corporate profitability.

Large‑cap stocks have been relatively weak lately, while the passive component sector is attracting capital against the tide. The surge in AI servers and high‑performance computing is rapidly boosting demand for advanced multilayer ceramic capacitors (MLCC) and chip resistors. Combined with the start of the consumer‑electronics peak‑season inventory build‑up and the continued rise in automotive‑electronics penetration, the supply‑demand balance for high‑voltage, high‑capacitance products is tightening, reviving price‑increase themes in the market.

Allianz Taiwan Dam Fund and Allianz Taiwan Technology Fund manager Hsu Hui‑Chung said that although long‑term U.S. Treasury yields remain high, putting short‑term pressure on tech‑stock valuations, the AI industry’s fundamentals remain solid. Demand for GPUs, ASICs, high‑end application processors, advanced processes and advanced packaging continues to rise, and North American cloud service providers are repeatedly raising capital‑expenditure plans, indicating that the AI investment cycle is still in a high‑growth phase.

Allianz Taiwan Smart Fund manager Chen Si‑Ming noted that short‑term market focus will center on capital flows, international political‑economic conditions and corporate fundamentals, expecting the broader market to stay in a high‑level oscillation while capital rotates toward stocks with tangible earnings‑growth themes.

Regarding corporate earnings, Allianz forecasts that profit‑growth momentum for Taiwanese companies will keep strengthening, lifting the overall corporate earnings annual growth rate to 84.07% for 2026 and projecting a further 35.56% increase in 2027. The electronics sector remains the primary growth engine, with its 2027 earnings growth rate estimated at 45%, reflecting structural growth opportunities driven by AI trends.

Looking ahead, Allianz’s Taiwan equity team is bullish on the AI‑related supply chain continuing to benefit from upgrades in computing performance and higher specifications. Areas such as IP/ASIC, advanced processes and packaging testing, PCB/CCL, ABF substrates, thermal solutions, water‑cooling modules and optical communications are expected to see rising component demand as new‑generation AI chips and server platforms roll out, which should lift industry profitability and product values.

In terms of investment strategy, Allianz’s Taiwan equity team says the current focus remains on the AI supply chain, targeting companies with growth drivers such as market‑share gains, higher penetration, specification upgrades and product‑portfolio optimization. Aligning with industry trends from 2026 to 2028, they will continue to seek investment targets with strong fundamentals and upside‑revision potential.

items.title: 2029告別「最不發達國家」！孟加拉告別關稅紅利積極轉型   力拚工業化擺脫成衣依賴
items.title_en: Bangladesh to Exit ‘Least Developed Country’ Status in 2029, Shifts from Garment Dependence to Industrialization
paras: 南亞國家孟加拉原定今年11月從聯合國「最不發達國家」名單「畢業」、轉為發展中國家，但聯合國發展政策委員會已接受其申請，把準備期延至2029年11月，市場更關注其後關稅優惠退場與產業升級能力。
隨著孟國總理塔里克·拉赫曼2月就職、結束前段政治動盪，國際投資人正重新評估這個南亞第二大經濟體的改革空間。
過去外資最詬病的是「跑印章」。有投資人稱，企業落地需往多個部門補文件，單一專案往往接觸六個以上審批環節。
但自今年8月20日起，孟國將投資發展局、經濟區管理局、公私合营管理局併入直屬總理辦公室的「投資孟加拉」(Invest Bangladesh)，目標是單一窗口、一站式辦證。
孟國國際與戰略研究所高級研究員阿希克(Mohammad Ashique Rahman)表示，外資進入後能否一次取得環境、用地、公司、稅務與勞工相關審批，是改革成敗關鍵；政府同時研究合併稅項、推進稅制簡化。
不過，業內人士也提醒，機構重組仍處過渡期，實際能效要看審批時程是否真正壓縮。
成衣(RMG)仍是孟國經濟晴雨表，佔出口八至九成。2025/26財年孟加拉總出口約480億美元、按年微降0.58%，其中成衣387億美元，低於550億總目標、成衣450億目標；7至4月成衣317.2億美元、年減2.82%，反映成本、競爭與歐美訂單放緩壓力。
官方還表示，部分財年統計的成衣淨收益年增約4.31%，企業保留外匯改善，但整體仍要靠多元化。
孟國央行設3000億塔卡出口多元化再融資，扶持皮革、黃麻、造船、輕工與ICT，對外已與日韓簽雙邊協定、推歐盟、紐西蘭、馬來西亞、阿聯談判，擬年內完成4至5個。
能源是隱患。中東戰事推高進口成本，先是今年3、4月燃油漲價，7、8月天然氣供應大減，發電、化肥與工廠受限。
IMF預估，孟國2026財年增長約4.7%、2027財年放緩至4.3%，通膨目標仍受挑戰。 改革若只停在招商簡化、未解電力與銀行不良貸款，投資落地仍會打折。
中資成為重要變量。塔里克6月訪中時簽訂「中國經濟產業園投資開發協議」，該園區佔地約314公頃、投資3億美元、特許50年，主打紡服、機械、電子資訊、生物醫藥與綠能，預計帶動10億美元投資、10萬崗位。
BEZA執行主席喬杜里表示，外資辦證由半年至一年壓至14天內。上海國關院南亞中心主任劉宗義認為，協議快速掃清歷史障礙，體現孟國工業化急迫性。
此外，Runner Automobiles董事會8月批准推進比亞迪本地生產，先以整車進口建經銷與售後，再轉本地組裝。訪孟中企普遍認為，孟國員工服從性高、制衣女工就業管道窄而珍惜崗位，但街頭無電動車、充電與關稅政策未明，量產仍需觀察。
分析人士指出，孟加拉從「政策招商」走向「系統營商」，單一窗口、成衣升級、中資園區與電動車試水若能同步，可緩解LDC畢業後關稅紅利消失的衝擊，但若能源、治安與部門協調跟不上，外資仍會停留在考察階段。
paras_en: Bangladesh, a South Asian nation, had originally planned to graduate from the UN’s ‘Least Developed Countries’ list in November this year and become a developing country, but the UN Development Policy Committee has accepted its request to postpone the transition until November 2029, prompting markets to focus on how the country will handle the loss of tariff preferences and its capacity for industrial upgrading.

With Prime Minister Tariq Rahman taking office in February and ending a period of political turbulence, international investors are re‑evaluating the reform potential of the region’s second‑largest economy.

In the past, foreign investors’ biggest complaint was the “stamp‑chasing” process. Some investors said that setting up a business required submitting documents to multiple agencies, with a single project often encountering more than six approval steps.

Since August 20 of this year, Bangladesh has merged its Investment Development Authority, Economic Zones Authority and Public‑Private Partnership Authority into the Prime Minister’s Office‑directed “Invest Bangladesh”, aiming for a one‑stop, single‑window service for approvals.

Mohammad Ashique Rahman, senior researcher at the Bangladesh Institute of International and Strategic Studies, said that whether foreign investors can obtain environmental, land, company, tax and labour approvals in one go is the key to the success of reforms; the government is also studying tax consolidation and simplification of the tax system.
However, industry insiders caution that the institutional restructuring is still in a transition phase, and the real efficiency gains will depend on whether approval timelines are truly compressed.

The ready‑made garment (RMG) sector remains the barometer of Bangladesh’s economy, accounting for 80‑90% of exports. In FY 2025/26 total exports are projected at about $48 billion, a slight annual decline of 0.58%, with garments at $38.7 billion, below the $55 billion overall target and the $45 billion garment target; from July to April, garment exports were $31.72 billion, down 2.82% year‑on‑year, reflecting cost pressures, competition and a slowdown in European and US orders.
Officials also noted that net garment earnings for the fiscal year grew about 4.31% year‑on‑year, allowing firms to retain foreign exchange, but overall diversification remains essential.

The central bank has set up a 300 billion‑taka export‑diversification refinancing facility to support leather, jute, shipbuilding, light industry and ICT, and has already signed bilateral agreements with Japan and South Korea while negotiating with the EU, New Zealand, Malaysia and the UAE, aiming to conclude four to five deals within the year.

Energy is a hidden risk. Conflict in the Middle East has pushed up import costs, first with fuel price spikes in March and April, then a sharp reduction in natural‑gas supply in July and August, constraining power generation, fertilizer production and factories.

The IMF projects Bangladesh’s FY 2026 growth at about 4.7% and a slowdown to 4.3% in FY 2027, with inflation targets still under pressure. If reforms stop at simplifying investment procedures without addressing power shortages and bad‑loan issues in banks, investment inflows will remain discounted.

Chinese investment is becoming a significant variable. During Prime Minister Tariq’s June visit to China, a “China Economic and Industrial Park Investment Development Agreement” was signed; the park will cover about 314 ha, involve $300 million of investment, enjoy a 50‑year lease, focus on textiles, machinery, electronics, biotech and green energy, and is expected to generate $1 billion in investment and 100,000 jobs.

BEZA Executive Chairman Jo Duri said that foreign‑investment approval times have been cut from six‑months‑to‑a‑year down to within 14 days. Liu Zongyi, director of the South Asia Center at Shanghai International Studies University, believes the agreement quickly clears historical obstacles and reflects Bangladesh’s urgency to industrialise.

In addition, Runner Automobiles’ board approved in August the push for local production of BYD vehicles, starting with full‑car imports for dealership and after‑sales service before moving to local assembly. Visiting Chinese firms generally find Bangladeshi workers highly compliant and garment‑worker jobs scarce and valued, but note the lack of electric‑vehicle charging infrastructure and unclear tariff policies, meaning mass production still needs observation.

Analysts point out that Bangladesh’s shift from “policy‑driven investment promotion” to a “systemic business environment”, together with a single‑window, garment upgrading, Chinese‑run parks and electric‑vehicle pilots, could mitigate the impact of losing LDC tariff benefits after graduation. However, if energy supply, security and inter‑agency coordination lag, foreign investment will likely remain at the scouting stage.

items.title: 百萬美元藝術品買家近半是Z世代 瑞銀揭密高淨值收藏家4大「轉型」趨勢
items.title_en: Nearly Half of Million-Dollar Art Buyers Are Gen Z, UBS Reveals Four Transformational Trends Among High-Net-Worth Collectors
paras: 由Arts Economics與瑞銀集團合作進行的《2026年巴塞爾藝術展與瑞銀全球收藏調查》顯示，高淨值收藏家的購藏行為正發生劇烈轉變。Z世代已成為藝術市場中支出最高的族群，其支出金額超過年長世代兩倍以上，且在百萬美元級藝術品買家中占比近半。不同於以往的炫耀性消費，年輕世代呈現四大收藏樣態：更看重作品的獨特性、稀有性與來源，並傾向在封閉、僅限受邀的私人圈子進行交流。此外，高達八成Z世代偏好自主研究，AI研究工具與應用程式的使用率亦出現爆發性成長。

Z世代躍升藝術市場最大金主 買力倍增

全球藝術市場的資本版圖正在快速翻轉。根據Arts Economics與瑞銀集團（UBS）聯合發布的《2026年巴塞爾藝術展與瑞銀全球收藏調查》，高淨值收藏家的世代交替效應正顯著擴大，其中Z世代異軍突起，一舉成為藝術品市場中支出最高的世代。
調查顯示，在2025年及2026年上半年，Z世代於藝術品上的消費金額大幅超越所有其他世代，總支出高出年長世代兩倍以上。更值得關注的是，2026年購買單件價格超過100萬美元頂級藝術品的收藏家中，Z世代就占了接近半數，展現出極為強勁的資本實力與購藏意願。

擺脫炫耀性消費 重視稀有性與隱私

巴塞爾藝術展行政總裁Noah Horowitz指出，Z世代為市場注入了新的期待與行為模式，推動收藏界的邊界持續擴展。Arts Economics創辦人Clare McAndrew博士則分析，現代高淨值收藏家的驅動因素已轉離傳統的炫耀性消費，轉而追求在緊密的人際網絡中建立實質連結，地位的象徵不再僅由價格決定，而是取決於作品的稀有性、來源、原創性以及發掘價值的過程。
調查發現，高達43%的收藏家將「獨特性與稀有性」視為擁有藝術品最重要的價值，在Z世代中該比例更提高至48%。此外，最年輕的Z世代反而最看重隱私，無論線上或線下皆更傾向在僅限受邀的私人空間交流，不願在公開網路平台上展示收藏。

家族傳承奠定基礎 自主研究與AI工具普及

在收藏起點方面，家族影響力依然扮演關鍵角色。28%的高淨值收藏家以家庭作為入門途徑，Z世代的比例更高達40%；而在繼承藝術品的Z世代收藏家中，有近九成選擇保留作品，彰顯家族資產配置與文化傳承的長遠效應。
在決策過程中，高淨值收藏家正變得更加自主且積極運用新科技。2026年有72%的收藏家表示購買前會進行中度或大量自主研究，Z世代這一比例更達80%。同時，58%的收藏家會透過線上資源獲取建議，使用App與AI工具進行研究的比例，也從2024年的4%急升至2026年的22%。
整體而言，Z世代不僅帶動了美術作品以外的多元收藏風潮，亦重視慈善捐贈與機構支持。未來如何精準對接這群具備科技素養、重隱私且資本雄厚的年輕收藏族群，將是全球藝術產業與資產管理領域的核心課題。
paras_en: The 2026 Basel Art Fair and UBS Global Collector Survey, conducted jointly by Arts Economics and UBS, shows that the buying behavior of high‑net‑worth collectors is undergoing a dramatic shift. Generation Z has become the highest‑spending cohort in the art market, spending more than twice as much as older generations and accounting for almost half of million‑dollar‑level art buyers. Unlike previous conspicuous consumption, the younger generation exhibits four main collecting patterns: they place greater emphasis on a work’s uniqueness, rarity and provenance, and prefer to interact within closed, invitation‑only private circles. Moreover, up to 80% of Gen Z favor independent research, and the use of AI research tools and apps has exploded.

Gen Z Has Leapt to Become the Art Market’s Biggest Spender, Doubling Buying Power
The global art market’s capital landscape is rapidly reversing. According to the 2026 Basel Art Fair and UBS Global Collector Survey released by Arts Economics and UBS, the generational turnover among high‑net‑worth collectors is expanding markedly, with Gen Z emerging as the top‑spending cohort in the art market.

The survey shows that in 2025 and the first half of 2026, Gen Z’s art‑spending far outpaced all other generations, with total expenditures more than twice those of older cohorts. Notably, among collectors who purchased single pieces priced over $1 million in 2026, Gen Z accounted for nearly half, demonstrating exceptionally strong capital and buying intent.

Shedding Conspicuous Consumption, Valuing Rarity and Privacy
Basel Art Fair CEO Noah Horowitz noted that Gen Z is injecting new expectations and behaviors into the market, pushing the boundaries of collecting. Dr. Clare McAndrew, founder of Arts Economics, explained that modern high‑net‑worth collectors are shifting away from traditional status‑driven buying toward building substantive connections within tight networks; status is no longer defined solely by price but by a work’s rarity, provenance, originality and the discovery process.

The survey found that 43% of collectors consider “uniqueness and rarity” the most important value of owning art, rising to 48% among Gen Z. Additionally, the youngest Gen Z place the greatest emphasis on privacy, preferring invitation‑only private spaces for both online and offline interaction and avoiding public platforms to showcase their collections.

Family Legacy Lays the Foundation, Independent Research and AI Tools Spread
Family influence remains a key entry point for collecting. Twenty‑eight percent of high‑net‑worth collectors cite family as their gateway, with the figure climbing to 40% for Gen Z. Among Gen Z collectors who inherit artworks, nearly nine‑tenths choose to retain the pieces, highlighting long‑term family asset allocation and cultural transmission effects.

In decision‑making, high‑net‑worth collectors are becoming more autonomous and tech‑savvy. In 2026, 72% said they conduct moderate or extensive independent research before purchase, with the proportion rising to 80% for Gen Z. At the same time, 58% obtain advice via online resources, and the share using apps and AI tools jumped from 4% in 2024 to 22% in 2026.

Overall, Gen Z is not only driving a broader collecting wave beyond fine art but also emphasizing charitable giving and institutional support. Accurately engaging this tech‑savvy, privacy‑focused, capital‑rich young collector segment will be a core challenge for the global art industry and wealth‑management sector.

items.title: 大盤創高後拉回 這12檔台股ETF規模仍創高 00927今年來漲幅翻倍居冠
items.title_en: Market Hits Highs Then Pulls Back, Yet 12 Taiwan Stock ETFs Still Reach Record Sizes; 00927 Doubles Gains This Year
paras: 大盤創高後拉回整理，但仍有台股ETF規模逆勢創高，根據CMONEY統計資料顯示，包括群益半導體收益(00927-TW)、國泰永續高股息(00878-TW)、元大高股息(0056-TW)在內有12檔規模創新高，其中以市值、高息型為主。進一步觀察這12檔今年以來含息績效表現，以群益 00927 上漲107.36%翻倍的績效居冠。
據了解，00927 群益半導體收益ETF每1、4、7、10月配息，成分股皆為享譽全球的半導體供應鏈大廠，整體持股布局橫跨IC設計、晶圓代工與製造、封裝測試等領域，完整涵蓋半導體產業生態系，主要集中在先進製程與成熟代工(台積電、聯電、日月光)，同時搭配傳統高息股(如瑞昱)，兼具半導體與高息兩大市場火熱主題，有助投資人把握半導體產業成長行情，還能兼顧收益需求。
群益投信台股研究團隊表示，國人熱愛台股ETF是因為其波動度相對個股與大盤來的低，現階段大盤頻創新高下，接下來面臨的挑戰更為複雜，台股類股輪動快速、個股波動性大，預期台股指數傾向高檔震盪，建議投資人可以透過高股息ETF來為投組增加抗震力，其中結合半導體科技產業成長前景的高股息ETF除了具低波動特性、可兼顧收益需求，還有AI熱潮所帶來的潛在資本利得可期，因此成為現階段資金配置的最佳選擇。

群益半導體收益 ETF 經理人謝明志表示，台股高股息ETF的特性偏向高配息兼具成長性的股票，涵蓋全產業配置能兼顧多元產業紅利，而台灣半導體8月營收年增61%大幅優於歷史平均，第三季在AI先進製程與高階封測驅動下，晶圓代工與封測營收預估季增15%至20%。第四季受惠旺季動能延續，族群營收料維持雙位數季增。台灣作為AI產業關鍵供應鏈，不論是先進代工、封裝等半導體電子產業相關供應鏈營運有望持續受惠，台股盤勢仍有望迎接第四季傳統股市旺季上漲契機。

paras_en: After the market hit new highs and then retreated for a pull‑back, Taiwan stock ETFs continued to grow against the trend. According to CMONEY data, twelve ETFs—including Qunyi Semiconductor Yield (00927‑TW), Cathay Sustainable High Dividend (00878‑TW) and Yuanta High Dividend (0056‑TW)—set new record assets, mainly large‑cap and high‑yield funds. Looking at their total‑return performance since the start of the year, Qunyi’s 00927 led with a 107.36% rise, effectively doubling its value.

The 00927 Qunyi Semiconductor Yield ETF distributes dividends in January, April, July and October. Its holdings consist of globally renowned semiconductor supply‑chain giants, spanning IC design, wafer foundry, manufacturing and packaging/testing, covering the entire semiconductor ecosystem. The portfolio focuses on advanced and mature fabs such as TSMC, UMC and ASE, while also including traditional high‑yield stocks like Realtek, blending semiconductor growth with high‑dividend themes to let investors capture industry expansion while meeting income needs.

Qunyi Asset Management’s Taiwan equity research team notes that Taiwanese investors favor stock ETFs because they are less volatile than individual stocks or the broader market. With the index repeatedly hitting fresh highs, future challenges become more complex: sector rotation is rapid and single‑stock volatility is high, so the index is expected to trade in a high‑range consolidation. They recommend high‑dividend ETFs to add resilience to portfolios, especially those that combine semiconductor growth prospects. Such ETFs offer low volatility, steady income and potential capital gains from the AI boom, making them an optimal choice for current fund allocation.

ETF manager Hsieh Ming‑Chih of Qunyi Semiconductor Yield explains that Taiwan’s high‑dividend ETFs tend to feature high payouts together with growth potential, covering a broad range of industries to capture diverse sector dividends. Taiwan’s semiconductor revenue jumped 61% year‑over‑year in August, far above historical averages. In Q3, driven by AI‑related advanced processes and high‑end packaging, wafer‑foundry and packaging revenues are projected to grow 15‑20% quarter‑over‑quarter. Q4 is expected to benefit from seasonal momentum, with the sector likely posting double‑digit quarterly growth. As a key AI supply‑chain hub, Taiwan’s advanced fabs and packaging firms should continue to thrive, keeping the market poised for a traditional fourth‑quarter rally.

items.title: 高檔震盪消化雜音 法人：台股Q4重回獲利驅動 資金輪動「這些」族群
items.title_en: High-Level Oscillation Sifts Out Noise; Institutions: Taiwan Stocks Return to Profit-Driven Q4; Capital Rotates into These Sectors
paras: 台股近期呈現高檔震盪整理格局，上攻 5 萬大關再等等。安聯投信台股團隊表示，近期全球金融市場持續受到美國利率政策、債券殖利率變動及地緣政治風險等因素干擾，市場波動加劇。不過，隨著消化相關不確定因素逐步被消化，第四季市場焦點有望重新回歸企業營收、獲利表現與產業基本面，台股也有機會由企業獲利驅動投資階段。
近期大型權值股走勢相對疲軟，被動元件族群逆勢吸引資金青睞。隨著AI伺服器及高效能運算帶動高階積層陶瓷電容(MLCC)與晶片電阻需求快速增加，加上消費性電子旺季備貨啟動及車用電子滲透率持續提升，高耐壓、高容值產品供需逐漸轉趨緊俏，市場再度浮現漲價題材。
安聯台灣大壩基金暨安聯台灣科技基金經理人蕭惠中表示，雖然美國長天期公債殖利率維持高檔，短期對科技股評價帶來壓力，但AI產業基本面依然穩健。從GPU、ASIC、高階應用處理器對先進製程及先進封裝需求持續提升，到北美雲端服務供應商(CSP)不斷上修資本支出計畫，都顯示AI投資循環仍維持高度成長階段。
安聯台灣智慧基金經理人陳思銘指出，短線市場焦點將聚焦資金流向、國際政經情勢與企業基本面表現，預期大盤將維持高檔震盪整理，資金則持續向具備實質業績成長題材的個股輪動。
在企業獲利方面，安聯投信預估台股企業獲利成長動能持續增強，2026年整體企業獲利年增率上修至84.07%，2027年可望再成長35.56%。其中，電子產業仍是主要成長引擎，2027年獲利成長率預估達45%，反映AI趨勢所帶來的結構性成長機會。
展望後市，安聯投信台股團隊看好AI相關供應鏈持續受惠於運算效能升級與規格提升趨勢，包括IP／ASIC、先進製程與封裝測試、PCB／CCL、ABF載板、散熱、水冷模組及光通訊等領域隨著新一代AI晶片及伺服器平台陸續推出，不僅可望帶動相關零組件需求成長，也將推升產業獲利與產品價值提升。
投資策略方面，安聯投信台股團隊表示，現階段仍以AI供應鏈為核心配置，聚焦具備市占率提升、滲透率增加、規格升級及產品組合優化等成長動能的企業，並結合2026至2028年的產業發展趨勢，持續發掘基本面具上修潛力的投資標的。
paras_en: Taiwan’s stock market has recently been in a high‑level oscillation and consolidation pattern, with the next push toward the 50,000‑point mark still pending. Allianz Asset Management’s Taiwan equity team said that global financial markets have been increasingly volatile due to U.S. interest‑rate policy, bond‑yield movements and geopolitical risks. However, as the related uncertainties are gradually digested, the focus in Q4 is expected to shift back to corporate revenue, earnings performance and industry fundamentals, giving Taiwan stocks a chance to be driven by corporate profitability.

Large‑cap stocks have been relatively weak lately, while the passive component sector is attracting capital against the tide. The surge in AI servers and high‑performance computing is rapidly boosting demand for advanced multilayer ceramic capacitors (MLCC) and chip resistors. Combined with the start of the consumer‑electronics peak‑season inventory build‑up and the continued rise in automotive‑electronics penetration, the supply‑demand balance for high‑voltage, high‑capacitance products is tightening, reviving price‑increase themes in the market.

Allianz Taiwan Dam Fund and Allianz Taiwan Technology Fund manager Hsu Hui‑Chung said that although long‑term U.S. Treasury yields remain high, putting short‑term pressure on tech‑stock valuations, the AI industry’s fundamentals remain solid. Demand for GPUs, ASICs, high‑end application processors, advanced processes and advanced packaging continues to rise, and North American cloud service providers are repeatedly raising capital‑expenditure plans, indicating that the AI investment cycle is still in a high‑growth phase.

Allianz Taiwan Smart Fund manager Chen Si‑Ming noted that short‑term market focus will center on capital flows, international political‑economic conditions and corporate fundamentals, expecting the broader market to stay in a high‑level oscillation while capital rotates toward stocks with tangible earnings‑growth themes.

Regarding corporate earnings, Allianz forecasts that profit‑growth momentum for Taiwanese companies will keep strengthening, lifting the overall corporate earnings annual growth rate to 84.07% for 2026 and projecting a further 35.56% increase in 2027. The electronics sector remains the primary growth engine, with its 2027 earnings growth rate estimated at 45%, reflecting structural growth opportunities driven by AI trends.

Looking ahead, Allianz’s Taiwan equity team is bullish on the AI‑related supply chain continuing to benefit from upgrades in computing performance and higher specifications. Areas such as IP/ASIC, advanced processes and packaging testing, PCB/CCL, ABF substrates, thermal solutions, water‑cooling modules and optical communications are expected to see rising component demand as new‑generation AI chips and server platforms roll out, which should lift industry profitability and product values.

In terms of investment strategy, Allianz’s Taiwan equity team says the current focus remains on the AI supply chain, targeting companies with growth drivers such as market‑share gains, higher penetration, specification upgrades and product‑portfolio optimization. Aligning with industry trends from 2026 to 2028, they will continue to seek investment targets with strong fundamentals and upside‑revision potential.

items.title: 台北101國慶煙火、無人機璀璨綻放夜空 台新新光金獨家贊助
items.title_en: Taipei 101 National Day Fireworks and Drones Light Up the Night Sky, Taishin Shin Kong Financial Sponsors Exclusively
paras: 歡慶雙十，由台新新光金控(2887-TW)獨家贊助的台北101國慶展演今(10)日晚間10點盛大登場。長達14分鐘的展演以「Onward Taiwan 一起點亮台灣」為主題，結合無人機、大樓煙火及雷射燈光特效，璀璨光影綻放臺北夜空，為雙十國慶獻上最美麗的祝福。台北101董事長賈永婕在致詞時特別表達對台新新光金控的感謝，而台新新光金控總經理林維俊則表示，能夠有機會連續兩年獨家贊助台北101國慶展演，讓民眾在重要的日子觀賞結合科技、藝術與創意的精彩展演同時，也共同向中華民國表達生日祝福，台新新光金控感到非常的榮幸。

今年台北101國慶展演規模再升級，無人機於台北101旁的夜空變換多款圖形，搭配璀璨煙火、建築燈光及動態雷射光束，照亮臺北夜空。台新新光金控超人氣吉祥物Richart也化身「慶生大使」躍上夜空，頭戴生日帽牽著Q版臺灣歡樂登場；Richart隨後雙手捧著生日蛋糕，可愛又溫馨的畫面讓現場民眾驚呼連連，紛紛拿著手機捕捉每一個精彩的畫面。林維俊說明無人機展演Richart與Q版臺灣「認真同行」、「獻上蛋糕」，象徵著台新新光金控將永續深耕臺灣，與民眾認真同行
臺北市政府廣場前，歡慶雙十的氛圍不只在夜空展開，在無人機、煙火及雷射光特效展演開始前，臺北市政府「熊讚」、台北101「Damper Baby」及台新新光金控「Richart」三大人氣吉祥物首度齊聚快閃亮相，與現場民眾熱情互動。三大人氣吉祥物難得同框，吸引民眾爭相拍照，現場歡樂氣氛持續到煙火施放達到最高潮，為國慶夜增添無比歡樂與溫馨祝福。
台新新光金控獨家贊助台北101國慶展演活動，除了國慶夜盛大的精彩演出外，台北101於10月9日至11日連續三晚，以台新新光金控「智慧好夥伴」為主題，於高樓層外牆進行點燈打字及雷射光束的表演，內容包括Richart手捧慶生蛋糕的可愛圖樣，延續國慶的歡樂氛圍。台新新光金控持續透過多元創新的形式深耕臺灣、陪伴民眾，以實際行動巧扮「智慧好夥伴」。
paras_en: Celebrating Double Ten, the Taipei 101 National Day show, exclusively sponsored by Taishin Shin Kong Financial Holding (2887‑TW), kicked off tonight at 10 p.m. The 14‑minute performance, themed “Onward Taiwan – Lighting Up Taiwan Together,” combined drones, building fireworks and laser light effects, creating a brilliant display across Taipei’s night sky and offering the most beautiful blessings for the holiday. Taipei 101 chairman Jia Yong‑chie thanked Taishin Shin Kong Financial in her remarks, and general manager Lin Wei‑jun said it was an honor to sponsor the show for the second consecutive year, allowing the public to enjoy a tech‑art‑creativity showcase on this important day while jointly wishing the Republic of China a happy birthday.

This year’s Taipei 101 National Day show was upgraded in scale, with drones forming multiple patterns beside the tower, complemented by dazzling fireworks, architectural lighting and dynamic laser beams that illuminated the city. Taishin Shin Kong’s popular mascot Richart transformed into a “birthday ambassador,” soaring into the sky wearing a party hat and pulling a chibi‑style Taiwan; he then held up a birthday cake, a cute and heart‑warming scene that drew cheers from the crowd, who captured every moment on their phones. Lin explained that the drone display of Richart and the chibi Taiwan “walking together seriously” and “offering a cake” symbolizes Taishin Shin Kong’s commitment to sustainably nurture Taiwan and walk hand‑in‑hand with its people.

In front of the Taipei City Hall plaza, the Double‑Ten celebration extended beyond the sky. Before the drone, fireworks and laser show began, the city’s mascot “Xiong‑zan,” Taipei 101’s “Damper Baby,” and Taishin Shin Kong’s “Richart” made their first joint flash‑mob appearance, interacting enthusiastically with the public. The rare gathering of the three popular mascots attracted crowds snapping photos, and the festive atmosphere continued until the fireworks reached their climax, adding immense joy and warm wishes to the National Day night.

Taishin Shin Kong Financial’s exclusive sponsorship of the Taipei 101 National Day show included not only the spectacular night‑time performance but also a three‑night lighting and laser display on the tower’s upper façade from October 9‑11, themed “Smart Good Partner.” The show featured Richart holding a birthday cake, extending the celebratory mood. Through diverse and innovative formats, Taishin Shin Kong continues to deepen its roots in Taiwan and accompany its people, embodying the role of a “smart good partner” in action.

items.title: 電子五哥第三季股價三漲兩跌 最新伺服器展望一次看
items.title_en: Electronic Five Giants' Q3 Stock Prices: Three Rises, Two Falls, Latest Server Outlook All in One Look
paras: 時序進到第四季，緯創(3231-TW)、和碩(4938-TW)及仁寶(2324-TW)第三季股價上漲，廣達(2382-TW)與英業達(2356-TW)則下跌，電子五哥第三季呈現三漲兩跌，其中，緯創第三季表現最佳，漲幅超過1成。同時，電子五哥也紛紛釋出最新展望。
緯創第三季漲16.4%，和碩漲7.16%，仁寶漲5.1%；廣達跌9.38%，英業達跌11.98%。雖呈現三漲兩跌，不過三大法人第三季加碼電子五哥，買超緯創最多，達16.39萬張，也買超和碩6.5萬張，英業達5萬張，仁寶4.9萬張，廣達1.8萬張。
電子五哥積極拓展伺服器業務，且持續受惠伺服器業務帶動，第三季紛紛繳出亮眼營收表現。廣達第三季營收1.16兆元、緯創1.15兆元、英業達2720億元、和碩3890.26億元皆創歷史單季新高，仁寶2427.77億元，則為7個季度以來新高。
廣達新一代伺服器產品依照既定時程推進中，第三季底已開始試產，預計第四季開始小量出貨，並在明年第一季營收放量；緯創則指出，AI伺服器為推升營收最主要成長動能，並帶動今年營運逐季往上，預計將在第四季迎來高峰；英業達表示，雖伺服器出貨受到關鍵零組件缺料影響，但公司積極追料，於9月有相當不錯的出貨，帶動營收表現，並預期動能將延續至第四季。
過去被認為在伺服器業務起步較慢的和碩與仁寶，相關布局也陸續開花成果。和碩指出，目前AI伺服器需求強勁，公司也已開始出貨，持續看好全年伺服器業績成長三位數，營收比重有機會達到1成。仁寶同樣看好旗下伺服器業務，第四季桃園大溪AI伺服器製造中心開始貢獻營收，力拚今年全年伺服器營收占比達1成。
paras_en: As we move into the fourth quarter, Wistron (3231‑TW), Pegatron (4938‑TW) and Compal (2324‑TW) saw their Q3 stock prices rise, while Quanta (2382‑TW) and Inventec (2356‑TW) fell. The “Electronic Five Giants” posted three gains and two losses in Q3, with Wistron delivering the strongest performance, up more than 10%. At the same time, the group released their latest outlooks.

Wistron jumped 16.4% in Q3, Pegatron rose 7.16%, and Compal gained 5.1%; Quanta slipped 9.38% and Inventec dropped 11.98%. Despite the mixed results, the three major institutional investors increased their holdings in the five companies during Q3, buying the most Wistron shares at 163,900 lots, followed by Pegatron at 65,000 lots, Inventec at 50,000 lots, Compal at 49,000 lots and Quanta at 18,000 lots.

The five firms are actively expanding their server businesses and continue to benefit from server‑driven growth, delivering impressive revenue results in Q3. Quanta posted Q3 revenue of NT$1.16 trillion, Wistron NT$1.15 trillion, Inventec NT$272 billion, Pegatron NT$389.026 billion – all record highs for a single quarter – while Compal recorded NT$242.777 billion, its highest in seven quarters.

Quanta’s next‑generation server products are progressing on schedule; pilot production began at the end of Q3, with limited shipments expected in Q4 and a revenue ramp‑up in Q1 2027. Wistron said AI servers are the main growth driver for revenue and will push quarterly operating performance higher, anticipating a peak in Q4. Inventec noted that server shipments were affected by shortages of key components, but the company actively sourced parts, achieving solid shipments in September that boosted revenue, and expects the momentum to continue into Q4.

Pegatron, previously seen as a slower starter in the server market, and Compal are now seeing the fruits of their efforts. Pegatron highlighted strong demand for AI servers, already shipping units and forecasting double‑digit annual server revenue growth, with server sales potentially accounting for 10% of total revenue. Compal likewise is optimistic about its server business, with its Taoyuan Daxi AI server manufacturing center beginning to contribute revenue in Q4, aiming for server revenue to represent 10% of its total sales for the year.

items.title: 蔡康永現身沈伯洋競總成立大會 中共喉舌怒批「兩面人」
items.title_en: Kevin Tsai Appears at Shen Bo‑yang’s Campaign Headquarters Launch; Chinese State Media Slams Him as a “Two‑Faced Person”
paras: 知名主持人蔡康永近日現身民進黨台北市長參選人沈伯洋競選總部成立大會，坐在貴賓區第一排觀眾席，手持加油棒揮動應援。
中共《人民日報》旗下權威微信公眾號「俠客島」9日（周五）表示，畫面曝光後，大陸輿論圈迅速炸鍋，大陸網友予以強烈批評。
「俠客島」說，大陸網友的怒火其來有自、理所當然。沈伯洋可不是普通候選人。早在2024年，他就被國台辦列入「台獨」頑固分子清單，2025年重慶市公安局以涉嫌分裂國家罪對其立案偵查，並向社會公開徵求線索。
「俠客島」稱，他創辦的「黑熊學院」實為「台獨基地」，長期明目張膽培育「暴力台獨分子」，向青少年兜售「台獨」主張和「仇中」思想，赤裸裸煽動分裂國家，嚴重危害台海和平穩定，嚴重損害兩岸同胞共同利益和中華民族根本利益。
「俠客島」強調，事出之後，蔡康永最先做的不是亮明立場，而是故意裝「中立」、試圖通過言語模糊蒙混過關，至今未認錯、未和「台獨」分子劃清界限，不提「一個中國」、不表態「台灣是中國的一部分」。
「俠客島」表示，像他這樣一邊賺大陸紅利、一邊給「台獨」分子撐腰的「兩面人」行徑，必須承受應有代價。
「俠客島」特別提到台灣藝人吳奇隆的舉動，並稱吳奇隆成了蔡康永最好的對照。大陸十一國慶期間，吳奇隆時隔33年再次來到天安門廣場，手舉五星紅旗，錄製國慶祝福短片，坦蕩表達家國情懷，贏得廣大網友一片讚譽。
蔡康永風波延燒，中共喉舌對他的批評似乎有所升級。共軍旗下媒體帳號「鈞正平」6日以「不點名」方式批判，但「俠客島」已明確點名蔡康永。
陸委會副主委兼發言人梁文傑8日對此表示，在台灣只要看哪個候選人順眼，覺得其講話有道理，那就可以支持他，不用擔心因為支持某位候選人，「然後（有人）對你怎麼樣」；在中共眼中不是這樣的，中共會用各種方式威脅你，讓你只能支持誰。
梁文傑強調，沒人希望台灣的選舉由中共決定，決定誰可以選，誰不可以選，「不然的話，我們就不用選舉，乾脆停辦算了」。
梁文傑說，選舉是件自由表達意志的事，台灣民眾已經習慣了，任何人想用威脅方式介入，必然招致反效果。
paras_en: Renowned host Kevin Tsai recently attended the launch ceremony of Democratic Progressive Party Taipei mayoral candidate Shen Bo‑yang’s campaign headquarters, sitting in the front row of the VIP section and waving a cheering stick in support.
China’s official People’s Daily WeChat account “Xia Ke Dao” reported on Friday the 9th that after the footage was released, mainland public opinion erupted, with netizens delivering strong criticism.

Xia Ke Dao said the anger of mainland netizens was justified. Shen Bo‑yang is not an ordinary candidate. As early as 2024, the Taiwan Affairs Office listed him as a “hard‑line Taiwan independence” element, and in 2025 the Chongqing Public Security Bureau opened a criminal investigation against him for alleged secession, publicly soliciting tips.

Xia Ke Dao claimed that the “Black Bear Academy” he founded is actually a “Taiwan independence base,” openly cultivating “violent Taiwan‑independence elements,” selling the ideology of “Taiwan independence” and “anti‑China” to youths, blatantly inciting secession and severely endangering peace and stability in the Taiwan Strait, as well as harming the common interests of compatriots on both sides and the fundamental interests of the Chinese nation.

Xia Ke Dao emphasized that after the incident, the first thing Kevin Tsai did was not to declare a stance but to feign “neutrality,” trying to blur the issue with vague language, still not admitting fault, not distancing himself from “Taiwan‑independence” elements, not mentioning “One China,” and not stating that “Taiwan is part of China.”
Xia Ke Dao said that a “two‑faced” person who profits from the mainland while supporting “Taiwan‑independence” elements must bear the appropriate consequences.

Xia Ke Dao specifically cited Taiwanese entertainer Nicky Wu’s actions, calling him the best contrast to Kevin Tsai. During the mainland’s National Day celebrations, Wu returned to Tiananmen Square after 33 years, raised a five‑star red flag, recorded a short video wishing the nation well, and openly expressed his patriotism, earning widespread praise from netizens.

As the Kevin Tsai controversy escalated, Chinese state media’s criticism of him seemed to intensify. The PLA‑affiliated media account “Jun Zhengping” on the 6th issued a “non‑named” critique, but Xia Ke Dao explicitly named Kevin Tsai.

On the 8th, Mainland Affairs Council Deputy Chairperson and spokesperson Liang Wen‑jie said that in Taiwan, if you like a candidate and think his words make sense, you can support him without worrying about “what they’ll do to you later.” That is not how the CCP operates; the CCP will use various means to threaten you so you can only support a certain side.
Liang stressed that no one wants Taiwan’s elections to be decided by the CCP—deciding who can run and who cannot. Otherwise, “we might as well stop holding elections altogether.”
Liang said elections are a matter of freely expressing one’s will, which Taiwanese people are accustomed to; any attempt to intervene with threats will inevitably backfire.

items.title: 磐儀看好半導體設備及醫療兩大動能延續 Q4展望審慎樂觀
items.title_en: Pan-Yi optimistic about continued momentum in semiconductor equipment and medical sectors, Q4 outlook cautiously optimistic
paras: 工業電腦廠磐儀 (3594-TW) 9 月、第三季營收創新高，展望第四季，公司看好半導體設備市場需求仍維持穩健，加上醫療影像與智慧醫療相關專案持續推進，持續挹注營收成長動能、後續展望審慎樂觀。
磐儀 9 月營收 3.1 億元創歷史單月新高，月增約 18%、年增 71%；第三季營收 8.3 億元同樣是單季最佳，季增 16%、年增 58%；累計前三季營收 20.59 億元，年增 47.5%。
磐儀表示，公司積極深化 Physical AI、智慧醫療、智慧製造及半導體產業應用布局，隨著全球市場對 AI 運算、智慧化設備及自動化解決方案需求持續提升，相關產品與解決方案出貨動能穩健增長，帶動營運表現。
隨著全球 AI 邊緣運算與智慧設備市場持續擴大，磐儀表示，近年積極布局高階運算平台、醫療影像及產業自動化等高成長領域，可望進一步提升市場競爭力，為未來營運成長增添動能。
磐儀也將與台灣物聯網協會於 10 月 15 日聯合舉辦「Physical AI 的未來十年與產業商機」專題論壇，匯集英特爾、無人載具聯盟、統一資訊、雙數工控、奕馬資訊、磐旭智能等眾多公司展出落地應用。
paras_en: Industrial computer maker Pan-Yi (3594-TW) posted record-high revenue in September and Q3, and looks ahead to Q4 with confidence that demand for semiconductor equipment remains robust, while medical imaging and smart healthcare projects continue to drive revenue growth, leading to a cautiously optimistic outlook.

Pan-Yi's September revenue reached NT$310 million, a historic monthly high, up about 18% month‑over‑month and 71% year‑over‑year; Q3 revenue was NT$830 million, also a quarterly record, up 16% sequentially and 58% YoY; cumulative revenue for the first three quarters was NT$2.059 billion, a 47.5% increase year‑over‑year.

The company said it is actively deepening its footprint in Physical AI, smart healthcare, smart manufacturing and semiconductor industry applications. As global demand for AI computing, intelligent equipment and automation solutions continues to rise, shipments of related products and solutions are growing steadily, boosting operating performance.

With the global AI edge computing and smart device markets expanding, Pan-Yi noted that its recent focus on high‑end computing platforms, medical imaging and industrial automation—high‑growth areas—should further enhance its market competitiveness and add momentum to future growth.

Pan-Yi will co‑host a forum titled “The Next Decade of Physical AI and Industry Opportunities” with the Taiwan IoT Association on October 15, featuring exhibitors such as Intel, the Unmanned Vehicle Alliance, UniInfo, Double Digit Industrial Control, Yima Information, and Pan-Xu Smart, showcasing real‑world applications.

items.title: 零組件漲價壓抑PC買氣 華碩、微星攻輝達RTX Spark旗艦機拚逆勢繳佳績
items.title_en: Component Price Hikes Suppress PC Demand; Asus and MSI Target Nvidia RTX Spark Flagship Laptops to Defy Market Downturn with Strong Results
paras: 面對全球個人電腦市場因零組件漲價導致終端買氣疲軟的嚴峻逆風，品牌大廠華碩(2357-TW)與微星聯手輝達(NVDA-US)，正式推出搭載RTX Spark超級晶片架構的Windows 11旗艦AI筆電，期望藉由超高規格的地端算力定位切入專業市場，在低迷市況中逆勢締造銷售佳績。
根據研調機構TrendForce調查，處理器、動態隨機存取記憶體與固態硬碟占主流筆電成本結構已高達68%，零組件價格高檔恐壓抑換機意願，導致2027年全球筆電出貨量面臨低個位數甚至高個位數的衰退風險，不過華碩與微星的首批RTX Spark旗艦機在預購階段即全數售罄，雙方更已向輝達追加配額，展現抗衡市況逆風的強勁動能。
微軟此次深化與輝達合作，將RTX Spark平台納入Windows 11生態系，主打在本地端GPU與雲端AI資源間動態調度，並持續針對系統底層進行最佳化，協助品牌廠擺脫傳統消費型機種的價格戰，轉向高附加價值的專業地端工作站定位。
在產品規格與定價策略上，華碩推出ProArt P14與P16旗艦機，128GB版本售價分別為249999元及269999元，並預計以169999元與179999元起提供64GB版本，首波機型預計10月16日晚上8點正式上市。
微星則端出首波唯一的可翻轉機型Prestige N16 Flip AI+，配備16吋UHD+串聯式觸控螢幕，128GB容量電商定價為239900元，64GB版本定價139900元，雙方高階主力機種售價皆超越20萬元大關。
RTX Spark最高整合20核心Grace CPU、6144核心Blackwell RTX GPU與大容量統一記憶體，FP4運算效能最高達1 PFLOPS，可直接於本機執行逾1200億參數的大型模型，精準鎖定企業與AI開發者等對價格敏感度較低的專業客群。
雖然整體PC出貨動能受零組件成本上揚壓抑，但地端代理式AI需求正快速崛起，華碩與微星透過頂級旗艦機吸引早期使用者買單，後續若11月第二批出貨能延續銷售熱度，加上入手門檻較低的64GB版本逐步放量，將可望成為兩大品牌在市況逆風下維持獲利與出貨動能的關鍵支柱。
paras_en: Facing a severe headwind as the global personal computer market weakens due to component price hikes, major brands Asus (2357‑TW) and MSI have teamed up with Nvidia (NVDA‑US) to launch Windows 11 flagship AI laptops powered by the RTX Spark super‑chip architecture. They aim to capture the professional segment with ultra‑high‑spec on‑device compute power and achieve solid sales despite the sluggish market.

According to research firm TrendForce, processors, dynamic random‑access memory and solid‑state drives now account for as much as 68% of a mainstream laptop’s cost structure. High‑end component prices are likely to dampen upgrade intent, putting global laptop shipments in 2027 at risk of a low‑single‑digit to high‑single‑digit decline. Nevertheless, the first batch of Asus and MSI RTX Spark flagships sold out during pre‑order, and both companies have already requested additional allocations from Nvidia, showing strong momentum against the market headwind.

Microsoft is deepening its partnership with Nvidia by integrating the RTX Spark platform into the Windows 11 ecosystem, emphasizing dynamic scheduling between on‑device GPU and cloud AI resources while continuously optimizing the system stack. This helps OEMs move away from traditional consumer‑grade price wars toward high‑value professional on‑premise workstation positioning.

In terms of specs and pricing, Asus unveiled its ProArt P14 and P16 flagships. The 128 GB configurations are priced at NT$249,999 and NT$269,999 respectively, while the 64 GB versions will start at NT$169,999 and NT$179,999. The first wave is slated to launch at 8 p.m. on October 16.

MSI’s first‑ever convertible model, the Prestige N16 Flip AI+, features a 16‑inch UHD+ stitched‑touch display. The 128 GB variant is priced at NT$239,900 for e‑commerce, and the 64 GB version at NT$139,900. Both flagship models from the two brands exceed the NT$200,000 price mark.

The RTX Spark platform integrates up to a 20‑core Grace CPU, a 6,144‑core Blackwell RTX GPU and a large unified memory pool, delivering up to 1 PFLOPS of FP4 performance. It can run massive models with more than 120 billion parameters locally, targeting enterprise and AI developer customers who are less price‑sensitive.

Although overall PC shipment momentum is constrained by rising component costs, demand for on‑premise AI is rising rapidly. By attracting early adopters with top‑tier flagships, Asus and MSI hope that a second wave of shipments in November will sustain sales heat. Coupled with the lower‑priced 64 GB models gradually scaling up, these products could become key pillars for both brands to maintain profitability and shipment momentum amid a challenging market.

items.title: 瞄準台股AI產業 施羅德首檔主動式ETF 00419A獲准募集
items.title_en: Schroders' First Active ETF Targeting Taiwan AI Industry (00419A) Approved for Fundraising
paras: 施羅德投信宣布旗下首檔主動式ETF「施羅德AI科技台股主動式ETF」(00419A-TW)正式獲准募集，這也是施羅德在台推出的首檔ETF產品，挾台灣樂活中小基金今年前9月報酬率達160.5%的氣勢，將台股團隊深厚的主動投資實力延伸至ETF市場。該檔ETF將從台股1800檔個股中嚴格篩選，聚焦AI半導體、基礎建設與新興應用，打造高信念投資組合。團隊憑藉優異的主動選股研究能力，期望在AI產業快速分化的環境下，協助投資人一站式掌握台股AI關鍵企業的長期投資機會。
隨著主動式ETF市場熱度持續升溫，外商資產管理大廠也正式加入戰局。施羅德投信宣布旗下首檔主動式ETF 「施羅德AI科技台股主動式ETF」（主動施羅德AI台股）獲准募集，這不僅是施羅德在台灣推出的首檔ETF產品，也象徵其長年深受投資人肯定的台股主動投資實力，正式跨足並延伸至ETF市場。
施羅德投信台股投資團隊指出，台灣已確立全球AI供應鏈重要樞紐的地位，相關投資商機全面擴散至半導體、AI基礎建設、光通訊、散熱及新興應用等多元領域。然而，在強勁的AI浪潮之下，企業之間的表現差異日趨顯著，能否精準挑選出真正具備核心競爭力的企業，將成為決定投資成敗的關鍵。因此，施羅德希望透過首檔主動式ETF 00419A，將長年累積的研究與選股能力，轉化為更便利且透明的ETF形式提供給大眾。
支撐這項市場信心的，來自於施羅德台股團隊長期交出的優異投資成績單。根據理柏統計至9月底，施羅德台灣樂活中小基金今年以來報酬率達到160.5%，在138檔同類型台股基金中高居第一；而根據投信投顧公會統計至8月底，該基金規模更較年初大幅成長超過7倍。施羅德強調，優異績效背後的核心關鍵在於深入的研究與主動選股能力，這也成為本次推出主動式ETF的重要基石。
在投資策略方面，主動施羅德AI台股（00419A）將從台股一千八百檔個股中出發，透過市值、流動性、財務信評與ESG等多重條件嚴格篩選投資標的，並高度聚焦於AI半導體、AI基礎建設及各項AI新應用領域，打造高信念的投資組合。透過主動式操作與動態調整機制，團隊希望協助投資人一站買齊AI半導體產業鏈，精準掌握AI產業的長期發展趨勢與關鍵投資契機。
展望第四季與未來市況，施羅德投信台股投資團隊認為，AI依然是電子產業中成長能見度最高的核心主軸。隨著輝達新平台陸續出貨，加上各大雲端服務業者持續擴大AI基礎建設資本支出，相關供應鏈企業的訂單能見度已順利延伸至2027年甚至更久，成長動能相較於傳統消費性電子更具競爭優勢。
施羅德團隊總結，AI產業的快速發展將持續帶動新一輪產業升級與資本支出循環，但各家受惠程度未必相同。在產業變化快速、個股分化愈趨明顯的環境下，主動選股的專業價值將持續提升。對投資人而言，與其單獨押注單一企業，不如交由專業團隊主動布局AI產業鏈中的關鍵贏家，更能有效且穩健地掌握長期投資機會。

paras_en: Schroders Investment Trust announced that its first active ETF, the "Schroders AI Technology Taiwan Stock Active ETF" (00419A‑TW), has been officially approved for fundraising. This is also Schroders' first ETF product launched in Taiwan, leveraging the momentum of its Taiwan Happy Small‑Cap Fund, which posted a 160.5% return through September this year, and extending the team’s strong active investment expertise in Taiwanese equities to the ETF market. The ETF will strictly select from 1,800 Taiwanese stocks, focusing on AI semiconductors, infrastructure and emerging applications to build a high‑conviction portfolio. Relying on superior active stock‑picking research, the team aims to help investors capture long‑term opportunities in key Taiwanese AI companies in a rapidly differentiating industry.

As the active‑ETF market heats up, major foreign asset managers are entering the fray. Schroders Investment Trust announced that its first active ETF, the "Schroders AI Technology Taiwan Stock Active ETF" (active Schroders AI Taiwan), has been approved for fundraising. This not only marks Schroders' inaugural ETF product in Taiwan but also symbolizes the firm’s long‑standing, investor‑trusted active investment strength in Taiwanese equities, now extending into the ETF arena.

The Schroders Taiwan equity team points out that Taiwan has cemented its role as a crucial hub in the global AI supply chain, with investment opportunities spreading across semiconductors, AI infrastructure, optical communications, thermal management and emerging applications. However, amid the strong AI wave, performance gaps among companies are widening, making precise selection of firms with genuine core competitiveness the key to investment success. Therefore, Schroders hopes to translate its years of research and stock‑picking expertise into a more convenient and transparent ETF format through the inaugural active ETF 00419A.

Supporting this market confidence is the Schroders Taiwan team’s track record of outstanding investment results. According to Lipper data through the end of September, Schroders Taiwan Happy Small‑Cap Fund has achieved a 160.5% return year‑to‑date, ranking first among 138 comparable Taiwanese equity funds; and per the Taiwan Investment Trust Association, the fund’s assets have grown more than seven‑fold since the start of the year. Schroders emphasizes that the core of this performance lies in deep research and active stock selection, which forms the foundation for launching the active ETF.

In terms of investment strategy, the active Schroders AI Taiwan (00419A) will start from the pool of 1,800 Taiwanese stocks, applying strict filters on market cap, liquidity, financial credit ratings and ESG criteria, and will heavily focus on AI semiconductors, AI infrastructure and various AI‑related applications to build a high‑conviction portfolio. Through active management and dynamic rebalancing, the team aims to help investors buy the entire AI semiconductor value chain in one go, accurately capturing long‑term industry trends and key investment opportunities.

Looking ahead to Q4 and beyond, the Schroders Taiwan equity team believes AI remains the most visible growth driver in the electronics sector. With Nvidia’s new platforms rolling out and major cloud providers continuously expanding AI infrastructure capex, order visibility for related supply‑chain companies extends through 2027 and beyond, offering growth momentum that outpaces traditional consumer electronics.

The Schroders team concludes that the rapid development of the AI industry will spur a new wave of sector upgrades and capital‑expenditure cycles, though the degree of benefit will vary across companies. In an environment of fast‑changing industry dynamics and increasing stock differentiation, the value of professional active stock selection will continue to rise. For investors, rather than betting on a single company, entrusting a professional team to actively position in the AI value chain’s key winners offers a more effective and stable way to capture long‑term opportunities.
