items.title: 中國原油進口回溫？96艘超級油輪將抵港、創2月底以來新高
items.title_en: China's Crude Oil Imports Warm Up? 96 Super Tankers Set to Arrive, Highest Since End‑February
paras: 中國原油進口動向出現回溫訊號。根據《彭博》彙整的油輪追蹤數據，截至10月10日，預計未來90天內將有約96艘超級油輪抵達中國，創今年2月底以來最高紀錄，且相關數據已連續3週上升。不過，中國原油採購是否已全面恢復，仍有待觀察。
美伊衝突爆發初期，全球最大原油進口國中國大幅削減原油採購。當時，連接波斯灣與國際市場的重要航道荷姆茲海峽實際上陷入封鎖，嚴重干擾全球原油運輸。
如今，駛往中國的超級油輪數量持續增加，成為市場觀察中國原油需求變化的重要指標。
不過，油輪數量回升尚不代表中國原油採購已全面恢復。數據顯示，去年同期駛往中國的超級油輪達111艘，高於目前的96艘。中國原油需求能否完全復甦，抑或如部分分析師預期，在年底前持續低迷，目前仍未明朗。
儘管針對過往船隻的攻擊事件仍持續發生，近幾週荷姆茲海峽的原油運輸量已回升至接近戰前水準，為中國恢復大規模原油採購提供物流條件。
自美伊衝突爆發以來，交易員持續關注中國的原油採購規模。由於中國在全球原油市場占有重要地位，若需求持續回升，可能對國際油價產生實質影響。
目前，駛往中國的超級油輪數量及後續變化，仍是市場評估全球原油供需走勢的重要觀察指標。
paras_en: China's crude oil import trend shows signs of warming. According to Bloomberg's compiled tanker tracking data, as of October 10 about 96 super‑tankers are expected to arrive in China over the next 90 days, a record high since the end of February, and the figures have risen for three consecutive weeks. However, whether China's crude purchases have fully recovered remains to be seen.

In the early stage of the US‑Iran conflict, China, the world's largest crude importer, sharply cut its oil purchases. At that time the strategic Hormuz Strait, a key conduit between the Persian Gulf and international markets, was effectively blocked, severely disrupting global crude shipments.
Now the number of super‑tankers heading to China continues to rise, becoming an important gauge for the market to monitor changes in China's crude demand.

Nevertheless, the rebound in tanker numbers does not mean that China's crude buying has fully resumed. Data show that in the same period last year, 111 super‑tankers sailed to China, higher than the current 96. It is still unclear whether Chinese crude demand will fully recover or, as some analysts expect, stay weak through year‑end.

Despite ongoing attacks on vessels, crude flows through the Hormuz Strait have risen in recent weeks to near pre‑conflict levels, providing the logistical conditions for China to resume large‑scale crude purchases.

Since the outbreak of the US‑Iran conflict, traders have closely watched the scale of China's crude procurement. Because China holds a pivotal role in the global oil market, a sustained demand rebound could have a material impact on international oil prices.
The current volume of super‑tankers heading to China and its subsequent changes remain a key indicator for the market in assessing global crude supply‑and‑demand dynamics.

items.title: 看好開放模型！輝達洽談加碼投資Reflection AI、提供算力
items.title_en: Optimistic About Open-Weight Models! Nvidia Talks to Increase Investment in Reflection AI, Provide Compute
paras: 彭博引述消息人士寶島，輝達(NVDA-US) 正與 Reflection AI 洽談，考慮增加對這家新創公司的投資，或提供算力，以深化與這家開放權重模型重要開發商的合作關係。
消息人士指出，洽談仍處於初步階段，雙方尚未達成任何條件。
《金融時報》先前報導，相關洽談可能促成收購提議。可能的交易方式包括「人才收購」，也就是輝達聘用 Reflection 的員工並取得技術授權；提供更多晶片給這家新創公司；或提高輝達的持股投資。
Reflection 本月稍早推出首款開放權重模型 Beam，進軍中國新創公司占有一席之地的市場。開放權重模型會公開模型參數，也就是權重，讓其他人能免費使用並修改相關技術。
Reflection 表示，Beam 的設計目標是以低於許多競爭產品的成本，在程式編寫和 AI 代理任務上為企業客戶與開發者提供良好表現。
該公司指出，Beam 在進階推理基準測試中的成績與中國智譜 AI（Z.AI）的旗艦開放模型 GLM-5.2 相當。
Reflection 由兩名前 Google DeepMind 研究人員創立。《華爾街日報》先前報導，該公司曾洽談募資 25 億美元，估值達 250 億美元。
Reflection 也與馬斯克旗下的 SpaceX(SPCX-US) 及雲端服務業者 Nebius Group NV 簽下數十億美元合約，以取得開發模型所需的算力。
若輝達與 Reflection 達成合作，將為這家晶片製造商近幾個月一連串交易再添一筆。身為全球市值最高的公司，輝達運用雄厚財力扶植更廣泛的 AI 產業。
相關交易包括今年 9 月以 130 億美元收購 AI 模型公司 Hugging Face，以及與晶片新創公司 Groq 簽署約 200 億美元的授權協議。
輝達執行長黃仁勳也是開放權重模型的主要支持者。美國發展這類技術，有望降低新創公司對中國開放權重模型的依賴。相較於 OpenAI 和 Anthropic PBC 等美國公司的模型，中國模型使用成本低得多，智能表現也沒有落後太多。
美國政府也在鼓勵此類模型的發展。
美國總統川普 2025 年 7 月提出的 AI 行動計畫指出：「我們必須確保美國擁有以美國價值觀為基礎的領先開放模型。開源與開放權重模型，可能在部分商業領域及全球學術研究中成為標準。」
paras_en: Bloomberg, citing sources on the island, reports that Nvidia (NVDA-US) is in talks with Reflection AI about potentially increasing its investment in the startup or providing compute power, deepening its partnership with the important open-weight model developer.
Sources say the discussions are still in early stages and no terms have been agreed upon yet.

The Financial Times previously reported that the talks could lead to an acquisition proposal. Possible deal structures include a "talent acquisition"—Nvidia hiring Reflection staff and licensing the technology—providing more chips to the startup, or increasing Nvidia's equity stake.

Reflection launched its first open-weight model, Beam, earlier this month, entering a market where Chinese startups have a foothold. Open-weight models publish their parameters, i.e., weights, so others can use and modify the technology for free.
Reflection says Beam is designed to deliver strong performance for enterprise customers and developers on coding and AI-agent tasks at a cost lower than many competing products.
The company notes that Beam’s results on advanced inference benchmark tests are comparable to Zhipu AI’s (Z.AI) flagship open model GLM‑5.2.
Reflection was founded by two former Google DeepMind researchers. The Wall Street Journal previously reported the company had been in talks to raise $2.5 billion at a $25 billion valuation.
Reflection has also signed multi‑billion‑dollar contracts with Elon Musk’s SpaceX (SPCX-US) and cloud provider Nebius Group NV to secure the compute needed to develop its models.

If Nvidia and Reflection reach a deal, it would add another transaction to a series of deals Nvidia has completed in recent months. As the world’s most valuable company, Nvidia is using its deep pockets to foster a broader AI ecosystem.
Related deals include the September‑2023 $13 billion acquisition of AI model company Hugging Face and a roughly $20 billion licensing agreement with chip startup Groq.

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is also a major advocate of open-weight models. Developing such technology in the United States could reduce startups’ reliance on Chinese open-weight models. Compared with U.S. models from OpenAI and Anthropic PBC, Chinese models are much cheaper to run and are not far behind in performance.
The U.S. government is also encouraging the development of these models.

President Trump’s AI Action Plan, proposed for July 2025, states: "We must ensure the United States has leading open models grounded in American values. Open‑source and open‑weight models may become the standard in certain commercial sectors and global academic research."

items.title: H-1B數據與范斯說法有落差？微軟多數核准者早已在職  亞馬遜、Meta人多卻未受限
items.title_en: H‑1B Data Contradicts Vance’s Claim? Most of Microsoft’s Approved Workers Were Already Employees; Amazon and Meta Have Many H‑1B Holders Yet Face No Restrictions
paras: 美國副總統范斯（JD Vance）指控，微軟(MSFT-US) 2025年裁撤6,000名員工後，改以持H-1B工作簽證的外籍勞工填補職缺。不過，美國公民及移民服務局（USCIS）的簽證核准數據顯示，微軟去年獲准的H-1B簽證中，約三分之二是給已在公司任職的員工，並非新聘人員。
根據《CNBC》報導，川普政府週四（8日）宣布，暫停8家科技公司透過勞工部PERM計畫為外籍員工申請綠卡的資格。
這項措施暫停的是美國勞工部的PERM綠卡申請計畫，該計畫涉及協助移民取得永久居留權的程序，並不影響H-1B臨時工作簽證。
不過，H-1B簽證核准數據仍能反映這些企業對外籍勞工的依賴程度。
值得注意的是，根據美國公民及移民服務局的H-1B雇主數據中心，亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 與Meta(META-US) 是2025財政年度獲准H-1B簽證最多的兩家企業，分別取得19,178件及6,294件核准，但兩家公司均未被列入暫停名單。微軟則以6,258件緊追在後。
范斯在週四的記者會上表示，微軟2025年裁撤6,000名員工，卻大量聘用持H-1B簽證的外籍勞工。
他聲稱：「如果算一下，每裁掉一名員工，微軟就以1.5名外籍契約勞工取代他們。」不過，范斯同時強調，微軟是一家優秀的美國企業，雙方維持良好關係。
然而，報導指出，簽證數據顯示，儘管微軟去年確實取得超過6,000件H-1B簽證核准，但其中約三分之二的受益人原本就已在微軟工作。
相較之下，亞馬遜去年取得的H-1B核准數量約為微軟的3倍，且新聘的H-1B員工人數接近微軟的4倍，但亞馬遜卻並未被列入暫停名單。
此次遭暫停PERM計畫申請資格的8家企業，全都名列美國H-1B簽證核准數量前50大雇主，其中多數為資訊科技服務及顧問公司，Adobe(ADBE-US) 則排名第45，是名單中規模最小的企業。
從整體排名來看，亞馬遜與Meta的H-1B簽證核准數量均高於微軟，卻未遭到同樣處置。微軟過去多年一直是H-1B簽證的主要雇主，但亞馬遜在2017年超越微軟後，兩者的差距持續擴大。
川普政府此次整頓行動不僅針對科技業。勞工部監察長德艾斯波西托（Anthony D’Esposito）同日在記者會上宣布，將調查9所美國知名大學涉嫌涉及J-1簽證詐欺的案件。
川普的支持者長期主張，企業透過相關簽證計畫聘用外國人，可能削弱美國勞工的就業機會。
paras_en: U.S. Vice President JD Vance accused Microsoft (MSFT‑US) of replacing 6,000 jobs slated for elimination in 2025 with foreign workers on H‑1B visas. However, data from U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) shows that about two‑thirds of the H‑1B visas Microsoft received approval for last year were granted to employees already working at the company, not to new hires.

According to a CNBC report, the Trump administration announced on Thursday (the 8th) that it would suspend eight technology companies from using the Department of Labor’s PERM program to apply for green cards for foreign employees.
The suspension applies to the Department of Labor’s PERM green‑card application program, which assists immigrants in obtaining permanent residency, and does not affect the temporary H‑1B work visa.
Nevertheless, H‑1B approval data still reflects how much these firms rely on foreign labor.

Notably, USCIS’s H‑1B employer data center shows that Amazon (AMZN‑US) and Meta (META‑US) were the two companies with the most H‑1B approvals for fiscal year 2025, receiving 19,178 and 6,294 approvals respectively, and neither was placed on the suspension list. Microsoft followed closely with 6,258 approvals.
Vance said at Thursday’s press conference that Microsoft will cut 6,000 jobs in 2025 but will hire a large number of foreign workers on H‑1B visas.

He claimed, “If you do the math, Microsoft replaces each laid‑off employee with 1.5 foreign contract workers.” He also emphasized that Microsoft is a great American company and that relations remain good.

However, the report notes that visa data shows that although Microsoft did receive more than 6,000 H‑1B approvals last year, roughly two‑thirds of the beneficiaries were already employed by Microsoft.

In contrast, Amazon’s H‑1B approvals last year were about three times Microsoft’s, and the number of newly hired H‑1B employees was nearly four times Microsoft’s, yet Amazon was not placed on the suspension list.

All eight firms whose PERM applications were suspended are among the top 50 U.S. H‑1B employers, most of them information‑technology services and consulting firms; Adobe (ADBE‑US) ranks 45th and is the smallest company on the list.

Overall, Amazon and Meta have higher H‑1B approval counts than Microsoft but were not treated the same. Microsoft has long been a major H‑1B employer, but after Amazon overtook it in 2017, the gap has continued to widen.

The Trump administration’s crackdown is not limited to the tech sector. Department of Labor Inspector General Anthony D’Esposito announced at the same press conference that investigations will be launched into nine well‑known U.S. universities suspected of J‑1 visa fraud.
Trump supporters have long argued that companies hiring foreigners through these visa programs may diminish employment opportunities for American workers.

items.title: 馬斯克放話Terrafab會做出「比誰都好的晶片」
items.title_en: Musk Says Terrafab Will Produce “Better Chips Than Anyone”
paras: 馬斯克表示，他認為旗下公司憑藉打造客製化設備的經驗，「很可能會找出方法，做出比任何人都好的晶片」。
馬斯克週六(10日)於德州奧斯汀特斯拉（Tesla）超級工廠外舉行的「X Takeover」活動中，透過線上直播向現場客戶與投資人坦言，雖然目前對微晶片製造「一無所知，但我們會找出辦法」。
他指出，在參訪競爭對手的廠房時，並未看到太多客製化設備，而旗下團隊在此領域累積了豐富經驗，足以優化製造流程。
「我想可以肯定地說，這是全世界最困難的事情之一，」馬斯克表示：「我並非自滿或自以為是，但說實話，我認為我們大概能找出比任何人都優異的晶片製造方式。我不知道這需要多久時間，可能需要好幾年。」
馬斯克正準備透過特斯拉(TSLA-US) 、SpaceX(SPCX-US) 與英特爾(INTC-US) 的合資企業，於德州格林姆斯（Grimes）興建一座名為「Terrafab」的晶片廠，初始投資金額超過150億美元。
該計畫預計創造3,000個工作機會，並獲得德州企業基金（Texas Enterprise Fund）補助3,000萬美元。
這座占地達1,000萬平方英呎的設施將分期興建，建案腹地約為3,000英畝，而 SpaceX 目前在當地掌控的土地更超過1.3萬英畝。
6 月上市的 SpaceX 近期股價重返每股 135 美元的首次公開發行（IPO）價格之上，讓馬斯克成為全球首位兆美元富豪。
該公司正接近與投資公司 Grain Management LLC 達成協議，取得所需頻譜，進而成為行動電信業者，與 T-Mobile、威訊（Verizon）及 AT&T 競爭。
特斯拉上週五公布聲明指出，第 3 季全球交車量達 486,532 輛，優於市場預期。彭博彙整的分析師預估，平均交車量為 463,761 輛。
在汽車銷量下滑、股價表現落後一段時間後，這項成績為特斯拉帶來利多。公司計畫今年投入超過 250 億美元擴建工廠營運並推動 Robotaxi 業務，並已取得 300 億美元的新貸款與信用額度，以支應成長。
paras_en: Musk said he believes his companies, leveraging experience in building custom equipment, are "very likely to find a way to make chips better than anyone else's."

Musk on Saturday (the 10th) at the Tesla Gigafactory in Austin, Texas, during an "X Takeover" event held outside the plant, told customers and investors via live stream that although they currently know "nothing" about microchip manufacturing, they will find a way.
He noted that when visiting competitors' factories, he did not see many custom machines, and his team's extensive experience in that field is enough to optimise the manufacturing process.

I think I can say with confidence that this is one of the hardest things in the world," Musk said. "I'm not being arrogant, but honestly I think we can probably discover a chip‑making method that outperforms anyone else's. I don't know how long it will take—maybe several years."

Musk is preparing to build a chip fab called "Terrafab" in Grimes, Texas, through a joint venture of Tesla (TSLA-US), SpaceX (SPCX-US) and Intel (INTC-US), with an initial investment of over $15 billion.
The project is expected to create 3,000 jobs and will receive a $30 million grant from the Texas Enterprise Fund.
The 10‑million‑square‑foot facility will be built in phases on a site of about 3,000 acres, while SpaceX already controls more than 13,000 acres in the area.
SpaceX, which went public in June, has recently seen its share price rise back above its IPO price of $135 per share, making Musk the world’s first trillion‑dollar billionaire.

The company is close to reaching an agreement with investment firm Grain Management LLC to acquire the necessary spectrum and become a mobile telecom operator, competing with T‑Mobile, Verizon and AT&T.
Tesla announced on Friday that third‑quarter global deliveries reached 486,532 vehicles, beating market expectations. Bloomberg’s consensus estimate was an average of 463,761 deliveries.

After a period of declining auto sales and lagging stock performance, this result is a tailwind for Tesla. The company plans to invest more than $25 billion this year to expand factory operations and launch its Robotaxi business, and has secured a new $30 billion loan and credit facility to fund growth.

items.title: 橋水達里歐教戰AI泡沫避險！警告投資人：不知道的比知道的更多
paras: 美股主要指數本週重返歷史高點之際，橋水基金（Bridgewater Associates）創辦人達里歐（Ray Dalio）卻對人工智慧（AI）熱潮發出警告，認為市場已形成隨時可能破裂的泡沫。
根據《MarketWatch》報導，達里歐近日接受財經記者 Julia LaRoche 的 Podcast 訪問時表示，當前正處於一個風險極高的時期。他去年便曾提醒市場注意AI投資過熱的可能性，今年則進一步將當前局勢形容為面臨破裂風險的泡沫。
本週稍早，達里歐在新加坡舉行的《富比士》（Forbes）全球執行長會議上，也針對AI泡沫提出警告，特別點出投資人為押注這項技術而承擔的債務風險，尤其利率持續上升之際。
曾準確預見2008年全球金融危機的達里歐指出，1929年股市崩盤前，同樣出現過一場規模龐大的技術革命。這類革命往往伴隨高度不確定性，也需要大量資本投入。
達里歐上月曾在 Facebook 發文指出，投資人過去也曾熱衷押注電氣化等具有高度能見度的新技術。
然而，當股票價格被推升至過高水準，或投資人過度依賴債務進場，就可能重演1929年至1933年間的市場崩跌。
他認為，市場的一大問題在於，投資人容易將技術革命的價值與投資標的的價格混為一談，未能區分「偉大的技術突破」與「值得買進的投資」。
達里歐進一步指出，企業或投資人可以透過募集數十億美元資金或舉債，迅速擴大帳面財富，但要將帳面價值轉化為實際可支用的現金，難度則高得多。
他表示，投資人必須出售資產才能將財富轉換為可用資金，而這通常正是泡沫破裂的導火線。

美股創新高、10年期美債殖利率處20年高點 資產估值風險升溫

達里歐警告，AI投資熱潮正面臨債券殖利率攀升的考驗。隨著殖利率走高，既有債券價格承壓，股票相對估值也可能顯得更加昂貴。
目前，美國10年期公債殖利率徘徊在20多年高點附近，但標普500指數與那斯達克綜合指數本週仍雙雙創下歷史新高。
達里歐表示，資產對利率上升的敏感程度，是投資人必須密切關注的風險；當市場累積大量債務時，貨幣價值往後也可能面臨貶值壓力。
面對這樣的市場環境，達里歐建議投資人將投資組合的5%至15%配置於黃金，作為分散風險的工具。
他認為，黃金屬於具有實質價值的貨幣資產，在債務規模不斷擴大的情況下，有助於分散投資組合風險。
不過，黃金今年也受到債券殖利率上升與美元走強的壓力。由於黃金本身不會產生利息，當市場殖利率攀升時，持有黃金的機會成本也會隨之增加。
至於比特幣，達里歐透露，自己僅將約1%的投資組合配置於比特幣，主要目的是分散風險，而非認為比特幣是特別優質的資產。
他對比特幣仍有所保留，理由包括交易與持有活動可能受到監控、政府可能介入投資人與資產之間的關係，以及AI未來是否有能力破解比特幣相關機制，仍有待觀察。

達里歐點名大型AI股太貴 看好抗通膨債券

在股票投資方面，達里歐認為，投資人應留意那些有機會透過AI實現業務轉型的企業，例如藉由AI提高銷售額或降低成本的公司。
他認為，市場可能尚未充分反映這類企業的潛在價值。
相較之下，對於目前主導市場漲勢的大型科技企業與AI概念股，達里歐則抱持審慎態度。他直言，規模龐大的雲端運算業者及其他重押AI的企業，股價已經過高，估值相當昂貴。
除了黃金，達里歐也偏好抗通膨公債（TIPS），尤其是能放大通膨與利率曝險的槓桿型TIPS。
他預期，現金投資的報酬率將偏低，而目前抗通膨債券的實質殖利率約為3%，在他看來已具有吸引力，通膨壓力也可能持續支撐這類資產。
達里歐最後強調，未來2至4年將是風險相當高的時期，期間包括今年11月的美國期中選舉，以及2028年總統大選等重要政治事件。面對難以預測的市場與政治變化，投資人應重視資產配置的平衡與多元化。
他指出，對於未來將發生什麼事，投資人所不知道的，遠比已經掌握的資訊更多。

items.title: AI算力荒顛覆矽谷！科技巨頭搶破頭 競爭對手也得聯手找資源
items.title_en: AI Compute Shortage Disrupts Silicon Valley! Tech Giants Scramble, Competitors Must Join Forces for Resources
paras: 人工智慧(AI)算力供不應求，正在改變矽谷的競爭規則，隨著算力成為AI開發的關鍵資源，彼此競爭的科技公司開始合作取得運算能力，創投業者也將晶片資源視為吸引新創公司的重要籌碼。
華爾街日報(WSJ)報導，昔日勢不兩立的競爭對手開始建立新聯盟，例如全球首富馬斯克與Anthropic執行長阿莫戴(Dario Amodei)旗下公司便曾合作取得算力。
Google(GOOGL-US)則曾在2024年以27億美元重新聘回AI頂尖研究員Noam Shazeer，但Shazeer因獲得的運算資源有限，後來轉赴OpenAI。
舊金山算力供應商SF Compute執行長Evan Conrad說：「現在正發生一場大規模淘金熱，要完全理解這場競賽的規模並不容易。」
SF Compute負責評估資料中心，再將其算力出租給AI企業，客戶從輝達(NVDA-US)等大型業者到Standard Intelligence等小型新創都有。 該公司技術長Eric Park為尋找可用算力，走訪美國偏遠地區、馬尼拉及台北，甚至在一間改建自雞舍的設施找到伺服器。他也曾在馬尼拉遇上洪水，導致車輛拋錨。

算力價格飆升 新創被迫簽長約、付高額預付款

由於既有算力供應商都會要求客戶簽訂多年合約，並提高預付款，部分新創公司因此只能尋找供應不穩定的業者。
加拿大AI新創Cohere共同創辦人Nick Frosst表示，目前實際上真正可用的資源很少，許多已宣布的資料中心計畫最後遭到取消，或實際規模小於承諾。
開源AI新創Arcee透露，最近因為合作夥伴的資料中心延後完工，而失去一筆交易。
在強勁需求下，算力成本正在攀升。根據數據與顧問公司SemiAnalysis，以一年期合約計算，租用輝達(NVDA-US)晶片的每小時費用較去年同期上漲60%。Alphabet則預估今年資本支出最高可達2000億美元，其中很大一部分將投入AI基建。

高層親自出馬喬算力 連宿敵也得合作

即使是最忙碌的AI企業高層，如今也得親自介入算力談判。
Anthropic共同創辦人Tom Brown今年3月底層前往馬斯克旗下的xAI，洽談租用算力，據悉當時Claude Code大獲成功，Anthropic面臨算力吃緊及服務頻繁中斷問題。
Anthropic後來與馬斯克的SpaceX(SPCX-US)達成協議，租用超過300MG的算力，而且未來數年合約金額最高可達450億美元，消息震撼業界。
馬斯克過去曾公開批評過Anthropic，但在合作消息公布後，他在X發文表示，自己對Anthropic高層團隊的成員印象深刻。
報導說，阿莫戴今年稍早也曾聯絡Meta(META-US)AI長汪濤(Alexandr Wang)，試圖取得更多算力，但Meta經評估後暫不提供。而這些都還不算在Anthropic過去一年宣布的數千億美元算力交易中。
Google內部同樣為有限算力該如何分配而爭論不休。知情人士表示，在Google山景城辦公室，研究人員對哪些計畫應優先取得珍貴的運算資源產生激烈的分歧。共同創辦人布林(Sergey Brin)有時會打破正式的算力分配程序，將資源重新分配給他認為重要的計畫。

算力成新創生存關鍵 創投也下場搶資源

AI熱潮初期，大型與小型企業都能向亞馬遜網路服務(AWS)等業者租用AI晶片叢集，不必簽署多年期合約，也不必支付天價預付款。
但隨著頂尖AI實驗室大量吸收可用算力，雲端供應商開始要求客戶簽訂多年期合約，預付款有時高達合約金額的30%。部分供應商甚至要求新創公司尋找擔保人，在企業無力付款時代為履行合約。
對新創公司來說，挑戰不只是取得算力，還包括準確預測成長後究竟需要多少算力。 為降低取得算力的不確定性，有些企業簽下超過實際需求的合約，另一些新創則高估自家AI產品的需求，最終不得不轉售多餘的算力。
AI助理新創公司Instinct AI上個月募得10億美元，估值達100億美元，但面對資金與算力更充裕的Meta、OpenAI，仍可能難以競爭。執行長Noah Shinn正考慮是否提前購入足以支援假設中的1億名使用者的算力。
創投業者也開始預訂運算叢集，再出租給新創公司，或替企業保證算力合約。知情人士透露，去年Y Combinator旗下有一家新創企業需要120個圖形處理器(GPU)，進行為期兩個月的模型訓練，卻找不到合適的租用合約。為此，Y Combinator設立專供旗下新創使用的運算叢集，並於今年7月啟用。
專注AI投資的創投公司Radical Ventures，負責人David Katz帶領團隊 追蹤GPU供應、價格及合約條件，並協助旗下投資企業媒合算力供應商。 過去五年來，Katz已協商數十億美元規模的算力交易，並與新型雲端運算業者保持聯繫。
他說：「過去大家問的是『我要去哪裡找資金？』現在變成『誰能幫我？』這些公司並不缺資金，但真正了解如何建置這些設施的專業知識，卻相當稀缺。」
paras_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) compute power is in short supply, reshaping the competitive landscape in Silicon Valley. As compute becomes a critical resource for AI development, rival tech firms are beginning to cooperate to secure computing capacity, and venture capitalists are treating chip resources as a key bargaining chip to attract startups.

The Wall Street Journal reports that former fierce rivals are forming new alliances; for example, the world’s richest man Elon Musk and Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic, have collaborated to obtain compute power through Amodei’s company.
Google (GOOGL-US) re‑hired top AI researcher Noam Shazeer in 2024 for $2.7 billion, but Shazeer left for OpenAI after finding the computing resources allocated to him insufficient.
Evan Conrad, CEO of San Francisco‑based compute provider SF Compute, said, “We’re witnessing a massive gold rush, and it’s not easy to grasp the full scale of this competition.”

SF Compute evaluates data centers and then rents out their compute capacity to AI firms, serving customers ranging from large players like Nvidia (NVDA-US) to small startups such as Standard Intelligence. CTO Eric Park has scoured remote U.S. regions, Manila and Taipei for usable compute, even finding servers in a facility converted from a chicken coop. He once got stranded in Manila when a flood immobilized his vehicle.

Compute prices are soaring, forcing startups to sign long‑term contracts and pay hefty upfront fees. Existing providers demand multi‑year agreements and larger pre‑payments, pushing some startups to seek less reliable suppliers.
Cohere co‑founder Nick Frosst said that truly available resources are scarce; many announced data‑center projects have been cancelled or are far smaller than promised.
Open‑source AI startup Arcee disclosed that a delayed partner data center caused them to lose a deal.

With demand surging, compute costs are climbing. SemiAnalysis estimates that, on a one‑year contract basis, the hourly rental fee for Nvidia (NVDA-US) chips is up 60% year‑over‑year. Alphabet projects capital spending could reach $200 billion this year, a large share earmarked for AI infrastructure.
Even the busiest AI executives now have to get personally involved in compute negotiations.

Anthropic co‑founder Tom Brown traveled to Elon Musk’s xAI at the end of March to discuss renting compute. At the time Claude Code was performing well, but Anthropic was facing tight compute capacity and frequent service interruptions.
Anthropic later struck a deal with Musk’s SpaceX (SPCX-US) to rent over 300 MW of compute, with a multi‑year contract potentially worth up to $45 billion, a shock to the industry.
Musk, who has previously criticized Anthropic, posted on X after the partnership was announced, saying he was impressed by members of Anthropic’s senior team.

Reports say Amodei earlier this year also reached out to Meta (META‑US) AI head Alexandr Wang to seek more compute, but Meta declined after its own assessment. Those talks are aside from the trillions of dollars of compute deals Anthropic announced over the past year.

Google’s internal teams are also locked in fierce debates over how to allocate limited compute. Insiders say researchers at Google’s Mountain View campus clash over which projects should get priority access, and co‑founder Sergey Brin sometimes overrides formal allocation procedures to redirect resources to projects he deems important.

Compute has become a make‑or‑break factor for startups, and venture capitalists are now scrambling for resources. In the early AI boom, both large and small firms could rent AI chip clusters from providers like Amazon Web Services (AWS) without long contracts or massive upfront payments.

Now, as top AI labs soak up most available compute, cloud providers are demanding multi‑year contracts with pre‑payments that can reach 30% of the contract value. Some providers even require startups to find guarantors to back the contract if the company can’t pay.

For startups, the challenge isn’t just securing compute but also accurately forecasting how much they’ll need as they grow. To reduce uncertainty, some sign contracts for more capacity than they actually require, while others overestimate demand for their AI products and end up having to resell excess compute.

Instinct AI, an AI‑assistant startup, raised $1 billion last month at a $10 billion valuation, but faces stiff competition from better‑funded players like Meta and OpenAI. CEO Noah Shinn is weighing whether to purchase enough compute now to support a hypothetical 100 million users.

Venture capitalists are also pre‑ordering compute clusters to lease to startups or to guarantee contracts for portfolio companies. Insiders say a Y Combinator‑backed startup needed 120 GPUs for a two‑month model‑training run last year but couldn’t find a suitable rental contract, prompting Y Combinator to launch a dedicated compute cluster for its startups in July this year.

Radical Ventures, a VC firm focused on AI investments, led by David Katz, tracks GPU supply, pricing and contract terms, and helps its portfolio companies match with compute providers. Over the past five years Katz has negotiated tens of billions of dollars in compute deals and stays connected with emerging cloud providers.

He said, “In the past everyone asked, ‘Where can I find funding?’ Now the question is, ‘Who can help me?’ These companies aren’t short of money, but the expertise to actually build these facilities is extremely scarce.”

items.title: 美銀示警：民主黨若橫掃國會 美股面臨逾10%修正風險
items.title_en: Bank of America Warns: If Democrats Sweep Congress, U.S. Stocks Face Over 10% Downside Risk
paras: 《Marketwatch》報導，美國期中選舉進入倒數，國會控制權的變化可能成為金融市場下一個轉折點。美國銀行首席股票策略師Michael Hartnett 警告，若民主黨在下個月選舉中同時拿下參眾兩院，美股可能下跌逾10%，美元與美債殖利率也可能同步走低。
根據報導引述的預測市場數據，民主黨橫掃國會的機率已升至64%，高於1個月前的不到50%。共和黨失去眾議院、但保住參議院的機率約為28%，維持參眾兩院控制權的機率則約為9%。
Hartnett 認為，民主黨全面掌控國會，可能意味美國政策由「民粹資本主義」轉向「民粹社會主義」。在他的情境分析中，增稅與加強監管的預期，將對企業獲利及市場風險偏好構成壓力，也可能挑戰近年支撐美股的人工智慧 (AI) 資本支出熱潮。
他指出，民主黨為抑制通膨所推動的政策，可能衝擊目前的K型經濟格局。在這波經濟擴張中，高所得家庭受惠於資產價格上漲與較強的消費能力，若政策方向改變，支撐消費的財富效應也可能受到影響。
不過，Hartnett 認為，比稅負與監管更值得關注的是川普政治影響力的變化。
民主黨若取得國會控制權，將限制川普推動政策的空間，包括強化美國對戰略資源的掌控，以及維持相對於中國的AI競爭優勢。
在這種情境下，他預期美股、美元與美債殖利率可能同步下滑；國際股市則可能受惠於貿易及軍事衝突風險減輕，表現優於美股。
相較之下，若共和黨失去眾議院、但守住參議院，Hartnett 預估美股有望上漲逾5%。
他認為，分裂國會形成的政策僵局，可能帶來相對適中的市場環境，讓AI資本支出熱潮延續，並維持美元的強勢地位。
若共和黨保住參眾兩院，則是他眼中最有利於美股的結果，可能推動股市上漲10%以上，並進一步支撐AI相關投資行情。上述漲跌幅均為Hartnett對不同選舉結果的情境推估。
資產配置方面，Hartnett表示，儘管部分投資人仍等待美債殖利率升至6%才願意積極買進，他已傾向開始少量布局長天期債券，以及小型股、房地產投資信託等對利率變化敏感的資產，以掌握殖利率回落時的潛在機會。
paras_en: Marketwatch reports that the U.S. midterm elections are entering the final stretch, and a shift in congressional control could become the next turning point for financial markets. Michael Hartnett, chief equity strategist at Bank of America, warned that if Democrats win both the House and Senate next month, U.S. equities could fall more than 10%, and the dollar and Treasury yields could also decline.

According to market data cited in the report, the probability of a Democratic sweep of Congress has risen to 64%, up from under 50% a month ago. The chance of Republicans losing the House but retaining the Senate is about 28%, while the odds of maintaining the current split control are roughly 9%.

Hartnett believes that full Democratic control of Congress could signal a shift in U.S. policy from “populist capitalism” to “populist socialism.” In his scenario analysis, expectations of higher taxes and tighter regulation would pressure corporate earnings and market risk appetite, potentially challenging the AI‑driven capital‑expenditure boom that has supported stocks in recent years.

He notes that the Democrats’ anti‑inflation policies could disrupt the current K‑shaped economy. In the present expansion, high‑income households benefit from rising asset prices and strong consumption; a policy shift could undermine the wealth effect that underpins consumer spending.
However, Hartnett says that beyond taxes and regulation, the more important factor to watch is the change in Donald Trump’s political influence.

If Democrats gain control of Congress, they would limit Trump’s ability to push policies, including strengthening U.S. control over strategic resources and maintaining an AI competitive edge over China.

In that scenario, he expects U.S. equities, the dollar and Treasury yields to fall together, while international markets could benefit from reduced trade and military‑conflict risks and outperform U.S. stocks.
By contrast, if Republicans lose the House but keep the Senate, Hartnett estimates U.S. equities could rise more than 5%.
He argues that a divided Congress creating a policy stalemate could produce a relatively moderate market environment, allowing the AI‑capex boom to continue and keeping the dollar strong.

If Republicans retain both the House and Senate, Hartnett sees the most favorable outcome for U.S. stocks, potentially driving the market up over 10% and further supporting AI‑related investment themes. The quoted move ranges are his scenario‑based estimates for different election outcomes.

On asset allocation, Hartnett says that although some investors are waiting for Treasury yields to reach 6% before buying aggressively, he is already leaning toward modest positions in long‑duration bonds, small‑cap stocks and real‑estate investment trusts that are sensitive to rate changes, to capture potential opportunities as yields retreat.

items.title: 即使沒金融風暴 美債殖利率為何仍可能直奔6%？三大實體經濟支柱全解析
items.title_en: Even Without a Financial Crisis, Why Could U.S. Treasury Yields Still Surge to 6%? A Full Analysis of the Three Real‑Economy Pillars
paras: 《Marketwatch》報導，市場原本擔憂，殖利率快速飆升恐誘發槓桿投資人斷頭拋售，從而引發市場失序。然而，Mackenzie Investments 首席固定收益策略師 Dustin Reid 分析，美債殖利率完全有機會在不發生市場混亂的「有機狀態」下自然爬升至 6%，背後主要由三大經濟實體支撐。
當前債市正籠罩在一股非比尋常的氣氛中。即便財政部祭出買回長債的護盤舉措，基準10年期美債殖利率仍一路挺進至5.25%上方，刷出2002年以來新高，30年期殖利率也逼近5.6%。華爾街與全球金融市場的焦點已全面轉向下一個關鍵心理關卡：10年期美債殖利率是否會在無須引發市場恐慌的情況下，順理成章衝上 6%？
值得關注的是，儘管債市遭遇沉重賣壓，美股四大指數卻未出現預期中的劇烈崩盤，這顯示出當前市場資金在面對高利率環境時，展現出極強的適應力與韌性。
三大實體經濟推手 驅動殖利率「有機自然成長」
針對美債殖利率的強勁走勢，Reid 指出，雖然 6% 並非目前的基準預測，但在實體經濟強勁的支撐下，殖利率完全有能力以「有機（organic）」的方式自然達到 6% 的水平，且過程未必會伴隨市場失序或劇烈斷頭拋售。
支撐殖利率持續高企的核心因素主要有三：
能源價格黏性高企：原油及相關燃料價格持續維持高檔，為通膨帶來沉重的底部支撐，延緩了降息時程。
AI 資本支出潮源源不絕：科技巨頭（Hyperscalers）為了布局人工智慧並興建龐大的資料中心，資本支出居高不下，實體經濟對資金的需求異常強勁。
美國經濟成長基本面穩健：整體經濟表現優於預期，缺乏促使聯準會（Fed）採取預防性大幅降息的急迫理由。
此外，創下關注重建指標 MOVE 指數的債市資深專家 Harley Bassman 亦指出，美國政府高達 2 兆美元的龐大財政赤字，加上近年大量資金透過目標日期基金（Target-dated funds）以自動駕駛般的機制持續注入股市，使得資金並未如預期般大規模湧入債市撿便宜，進一步固化了「利率高企更久（Higher for longer）」的市場共識。
機構法人逢高鎖利 債市下檔仍具支撐
儘管 6% 的討論聲浪高漲，市場也並非毫無防禦能力。Reid 補充，當10年期與30年期殖利率分別來到 5.25% 與 5.6% 附近的相對高點時，均能顯著吸引主權財富基金、各國中央銀行以及退休基金等長線機構法人進場布局，藉此鎖定高額固定收益以平衡資產負債，這在客觀上為美債提供了關鍵的防禦支撐。
面對高赤字、高通膨與強勁經濟的交織影響，美債殖利率正迎來歷史性的重構期，投資人宜密切關注即將到來的數據與政策公布，提早做好資產配置的因應準備。
paras_en: Marketwatch reported that the market was originally worried that a rapid surge in yields could trigger leveraged investors to liquidate, causing market disorder. However, Dustin Reid, chief fixed‑income strategist at Mackenzie Investments, argues that U.S. Treasury yields can naturally climb to 6% in an “organic” manner without market chaos, supported by three major real‑economy forces.

The bond market is currently shrouded in an unusual atmosphere. Even though the Treasury has launched a buy‑back of long‑dated bonds to support prices, the benchmark 10‑year yield has pushed above 5.25%, hitting a high not seen since 2002, while the 30‑year yield is nearing 5.6%. Wall Street and global financial markets have now shifted their focus to the next key psychological threshold: whether the 10‑year yield can rise to 6% without sparking panic.

Notably, despite heavy selling pressure in the bond market, the four major U.S. equity indices have not experienced the expected sharp crash, indicating that current market capital shows strong adaptability and resilience in a high‑rate environment.
Three Real‑Economy Drivers Powering the “Organic” Yield Rise

Regarding the strong move in Treasury yields, Reid notes that while 6% is not the current baseline forecast, the robust real‑economy backdrop gives yields the capacity to reach that level organically, and the process need not be accompanied by market disorder or violent liquidations.
Three core factors underpin the sustained high yields:
Sticky energy prices: Crude oil and related fuel prices remain elevated, providing a heavy bottom‑up support for inflation and delaying rate cuts.
A relentless AI capital‑expenditure wave: Tech giants (hyperscalers) are pouring money into AI and massive data centers, creating unusually strong demand for capital in the real economy.
Solid fundamentals in U.S. economic growth: Overall performance is better than expected, leaving little urgency for the Federal Reserve to enact pre‑emptive large‑scale rate cuts.

In addition, senior bond‑market specialist Harley Bassman, who tracks the MOVE index, points out that the U.S. government’s $2 trillion fiscal deficit, combined with large inflows into target‑dated funds that automatically channel money into equities, means capital has not flowed into bonds as many had anticipated, reinforcing the market consensus of “higher for longer.”
Institutional investors lock in yields at the top, keeping the lower end of the bond market supported

Even with the buzz around a 6% yield, the market is not defenseless. Reid adds that when the 10‑year and 30‑year yields hover near 5.25% and 5.6% respectively, sovereign wealth funds, central banks and pension funds are drawn in to lock in high‑yield fixed income, balancing assets and liabilities, which objectively provides crucial defensive support for Treasuries.

Facing the intertwined effects of high deficits, high inflation and a strong economy, U.S. Treasury yields are entering a historic restructuring phase. Investors should closely monitor upcoming data releases and policy announcements and begin preparing asset‑allocation strategies in advance.

items.title: 立訊精密回應美337調查：涉案產品尚處客戶驗證階段 不影響營運
items.title_en: Luxshare Precision Responds to US 337 Investigation: Product Under Investigation Still in Customer Validation Phase, No Impact on Operations
paras: 立訊精密(02475-HK) 周六(10日)晚間應美國337調查，表示涉案產品目前仍處於客戶驗證階段，尚未進入量產，預期不會對現階段生產營運及當期經營績效造成重大不利影響；公司已啟動相關專利與產品研究，將積極應訴。
美國國際貿易委員會（USITC）當地時間9日宣布，應電源技術業者維克爾（Vicor Corporation）提出的專利侵權主張，正式啟動337調查，調查編號為337-TA-1526。
本案涉及美國專利US 10,903,734，調查範圍包括垂直供電系統（VPD）、相關組件，以及包含上述產品的計算系統，立訊精密與立訊技術均列入被調查方。
337調查是USITC依據美國《1930年關稅法》第337條進行的程序，主要針對進口產品涉及的專利、商標等智慧財產權侵權行為。若ITC最終認定侵權成立，可發布有限排除令或禁制令。
不過，本案目前仍在立案初期，USITC尚未對侵權主張作出實質認定。立訊精密公告指出，根據USITC公開資訊，Vicor先前曾多次針對資料中心電源相關技術，向產業鏈企業提出337調查。
根據公開文件，本案被調查方還包括台達電(2308-TW) 、英飛凌，以及鴻海(2317-TW) 、廣達(2382-TW) 等企業。立訊精密初步評估，涉案產品主要應用於資料中心，是電源模組與處理器的整合供電方案；目前產品仍在客戶驗證階段，尚未量產，因此公司預期調查不會對現階段生產經營及當期業績造成重大不利影響。
立訊精密表示，公司已第一時間啟動涉案專利及相關產品研究，並組成技術、法律與業務團隊，參考先前相關案件的因應經驗，制定策略與工作計畫。後續將積極應訴，持續進行專利技術分析、產品方案評估及必要的技術最佳化，並加強與客戶及供應鏈夥伴溝通，以推動相關業務有序進行。
立訊精密也表示，公司堅持自主創新、尊重智慧財產權，對自身技術研發能力及長期發展保持信心。公司提醒，本案裁決結果仍有不確定性，將持續評估對經營可能造成的影響，並及時履行資訊揭露義務。
立訊精密今年8月在業績說明會上表示，正布局銅連接、光連接、電源與熱管理等領域，推進AI算力基礎設施相關業務，並與主要客戶合作開發近芯供電、近芯散熱、銅光互連及晶片封裝整合等方案。此次調查涉及的資料中心供電產品，仍處於客戶驗證階段。
paras_en: Luxshare Precision (02475-HK) responded on Saturday night (the 10th) to the US 337 investigation, stating that the product involved is still in the customer validation stage and has not entered mass production, and it is expected that this will not have a material adverse effect on current production operations or the period’s performance; the company has launched related patent and product research and will actively defend the case.

The US International Trade Commission (USITC) announced on the 9th local time that, following a patent infringement claim by power‑technology company Vicor Corporation, it has formally initiated a 337 investigation, case number 337‑TA‑1526.

The case involves US Patent No. 10,903,734, and the investigation scope includes vertical power delivery (VPD) systems, related components, and computing systems that incorporate the aforementioned products; both Luxshare Precision and Luxshare Technology are listed as respondents.

A 337 investigation is a procedure conducted by the USITC under Section 337 of the Tariff Act of 1930, primarily targeting alleged infringement of patents, trademarks and other IP rights in imported goods. If the ITC ultimately finds infringement, it may issue a limited exclusion order or a cease‑and‑desist order.

However, the case is still in its early filing stage and the USITC has not yet made a substantive finding on the infringement claim. Luxshare Precision noted that, according to publicly available USITC information, Vicor has previously filed multiple 337 investigations against companies in the data‑center power‑supply chain.

Public documents show that other respondents in the case include Delta Electronics (2308‑TW), Infineon, as well as Foxconn (2317‑TW) and Quanta (2382‑TW). Luxshare Precision’s preliminary assessment is that the product in question is mainly used in data centers as an integrated power‑module‑and‑processor delivery solution; the product is still in customer validation and not yet in mass production, so the company expects the investigation will not materially affect current production or the period’s results.

Luxshare Precision said it immediately launched research on the implicated patents and related products, forming technical, legal and business teams, drawing on experience from prior similar cases to devise strategies and work plans. It will actively defend the case, continue patent‑technology analysis, product‑solution evaluation and necessary technical optimisation, and strengthen communication with customers and supply‑chain partners to ensure orderly business progress.

Luxshare Precision also affirmed its commitment to independent innovation and respect for intellectual‑property rights, expressing confidence in its own R&D capabilities and long‑term development. The company cautioned that the outcome of the case remains uncertain, will keep assessing any potential impact on operations, and will fulfil disclosure obligations in a timely manner.

At its August earnings briefing, Luxshare Precision said it is building capabilities in copper interconnects, optical interconnects, power and thermal management, advancing AI‑compute infrastructure business, and collaborating with major customers on near‑chip power, near‑chip cooling, copper‑optical interconnects and chip‑package integration solutions. The data‑center power products involved in this investigation are still in the customer validation stage.

items.title: 中國原油進口回溫？96艘超級油輪將抵港、創2月底以來新高
items.title_en: China's Crude Oil Imports Warm Up? 96 Super Tankers Set to Arrive, Highest Since End‑February
paras: 中國原油進口動向出現回溫訊號。根據《彭博》彙整的油輪追蹤數據，截至10月10日，預計未來90天內將有約96艘超級油輪抵達中國，創今年2月底以來最高紀錄，且相關數據已連續3週上升。不過，中國原油採購是否已全面恢復，仍有待觀察。
美伊衝突爆發初期，全球最大原油進口國中國大幅削減原油採購。當時，連接波斯灣與國際市場的重要航道荷姆茲海峽實際上陷入封鎖，嚴重干擾全球原油運輸。
如今，駛往中國的超級油輪數量持續增加，成為市場觀察中國原油需求變化的重要指標。
不過，油輪數量回升尚不代表中國原油採購已全面恢復。數據顯示，去年同期駛往中國的超級油輪達111艘，高於目前的96艘。中國原油需求能否完全復甦，抑或如部分分析師預期，在年底前持續低迷，目前仍未明朗。
儘管針對過往船隻的攻擊事件仍持續發生，近幾週荷姆茲海峽的原油運輸量已回升至接近戰前水準，為中國恢復大規模原油採購提供物流條件。
自美伊衝突爆發以來，交易員持續關注中國的原油採購規模。由於中國在全球原油市場占有重要地位，若需求持續回升，可能對國際油價產生實質影響。
目前，駛往中國的超級油輪數量及後續變化，仍是市場評估全球原油供需走勢的重要觀察指標。
paras_en: China's crude oil import trend shows signs of warming. According to Bloomberg's compiled tanker tracking data, as of October 10 about 96 super‑tankers are expected to arrive in China over the next 90 days, a record high since the end of February, and the figures have risen for three consecutive weeks. However, whether China's crude purchases have fully recovered remains to be seen.

In the early stage of the US‑Iran conflict, China, the world's largest crude importer, sharply cut its oil purchases. At that time the strategic Hormuz Strait, a key conduit between the Persian Gulf and international markets, was effectively blocked, severely disrupting global crude shipments.
Now the number of super‑tankers heading to China continues to rise, becoming an important gauge for the market to monitor changes in China's crude demand.

Nevertheless, the rebound in tanker numbers does not mean that China's crude buying has fully resumed. Data show that in the same period last year, 111 super‑tankers sailed to China, higher than the current 96. It is still unclear whether Chinese crude demand will fully recover or, as some analysts expect, stay weak through year‑end.

Despite ongoing attacks on vessels, crude flows through the Hormuz Strait have risen in recent weeks to near pre‑conflict levels, providing the logistical conditions for China to resume large‑scale crude purchases.

Since the outbreak of the US‑Iran conflict, traders have closely watched the scale of China's crude procurement. Because China holds a pivotal role in the global oil market, a sustained demand rebound could have a material impact on international oil prices.
The current volume of super‑tankers heading to China and its subsequent changes remain a key indicator for the market in assessing global crude supply‑and‑demand dynamics.

items.title: 看好開放模型！輝達洽談加碼投資Reflection AI、提供算力
items.title_en: Optimistic About Open-Weight Models! Nvidia Talks to Increase Investment in Reflection AI, Provide Compute
paras: 彭博引述消息人士寶島，輝達(NVDA-US) 正與 Reflection AI 洽談，考慮增加對這家新創公司的投資，或提供算力，以深化與這家開放權重模型重要開發商的合作關係。
消息人士指出，洽談仍處於初步階段，雙方尚未達成任何條件。
《金融時報》先前報導，相關洽談可能促成收購提議。可能的交易方式包括「人才收購」，也就是輝達聘用 Reflection 的員工並取得技術授權；提供更多晶片給這家新創公司；或提高輝達的持股投資。
Reflection 本月稍早推出首款開放權重模型 Beam，進軍中國新創公司占有一席之地的市場。開放權重模型會公開模型參數，也就是權重，讓其他人能免費使用並修改相關技術。
Reflection 表示，Beam 的設計目標是以低於許多競爭產品的成本，在程式編寫和 AI 代理任務上為企業客戶與開發者提供良好表現。
該公司指出，Beam 在進階推理基準測試中的成績與中國智譜 AI（Z.AI）的旗艦開放模型 GLM-5.2 相當。
Reflection 由兩名前 Google DeepMind 研究人員創立。《華爾街日報》先前報導，該公司曾洽談募資 25 億美元，估值達 250 億美元。
Reflection 也與馬斯克旗下的 SpaceX(SPCX-US) 及雲端服務業者 Nebius Group NV 簽下數十億美元合約，以取得開發模型所需的算力。
若輝達與 Reflection 達成合作，將為這家晶片製造商近幾個月一連串交易再添一筆。身為全球市值最高的公司，輝達運用雄厚財力扶植更廣泛的 AI 產業。
相關交易包括今年 9 月以 130 億美元收購 AI 模型公司 Hugging Face，以及與晶片新創公司 Groq 簽署約 200 億美元的授權協議。
輝達執行長黃仁勳也是開放權重模型的主要支持者。美國發展這類技術，有望降低新創公司對中國開放權重模型的依賴。相較於 OpenAI 和 Anthropic PBC 等美國公司的模型，中國模型使用成本低得多，智能表現也沒有落後太多。
美國政府也在鼓勵此類模型的發展。
美國總統川普 2025 年 7 月提出的 AI 行動計畫指出：「我們必須確保美國擁有以美國價值觀為基礎的領先開放模型。開源與開放權重模型，可能在部分商業領域及全球學術研究中成為標準。」
paras_en: Bloomberg, citing sources on the island, reports that Nvidia (NVDA-US) is in talks with Reflection AI about potentially increasing its investment in the startup or providing compute power, deepening its partnership with the important open-weight model developer.
Sources say the discussions are still in early stages and no terms have been agreed upon yet.

The Financial Times previously reported that the talks could lead to an acquisition proposal. Possible deal structures include a "talent acquisition"—Nvidia hiring Reflection staff and licensing the technology—providing more chips to the startup, or increasing Nvidia's equity stake.

Reflection launched its first open-weight model, Beam, earlier this month, entering a market where Chinese startups have a foothold. Open-weight models publish their parameters, i.e., weights, so others can use and modify the technology for free.
Reflection says Beam is designed to deliver strong performance for enterprise customers and developers on coding and AI-agent tasks at a cost lower than many competing products.
The company notes that Beam’s results on advanced inference benchmark tests are comparable to Zhipu AI’s (Z.AI) flagship open model GLM‑5.2.
Reflection was founded by two former Google DeepMind researchers. The Wall Street Journal previously reported the company had been in talks to raise $2.5 billion at a $25 billion valuation.
Reflection has also signed multi‑billion‑dollar contracts with Elon Musk’s SpaceX (SPCX-US) and cloud provider Nebius Group NV to secure the compute needed to develop its models.

If Nvidia and Reflection reach a deal, it would add another transaction to a series of deals Nvidia has completed in recent months. As the world’s most valuable company, Nvidia is using its deep pockets to foster a broader AI ecosystem.
Related deals include the September‑2023 $13 billion acquisition of AI model company Hugging Face and a roughly $20 billion licensing agreement with chip startup Groq.

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is also a major advocate of open-weight models. Developing such technology in the United States could reduce startups’ reliance on Chinese open-weight models. Compared with U.S. models from OpenAI and Anthropic PBC, Chinese models are much cheaper to run and are not far behind in performance.
The U.S. government is also encouraging the development of these models.

President Trump’s AI Action Plan, proposed for July 2025, states: "We must ensure the United States has leading open models grounded in American values. Open‑source and open‑weight models may become the standard in certain commercial sectors and global academic research."

items.title: H-1B數據與范斯說法有落差？微軟多數核准者早已在職  亞馬遜、Meta人多卻未受限
items.title_en: H‑1B Data Contradicts Vance’s Claim? Most of Microsoft’s Approved Workers Were Already Employees; Amazon and Meta Have Many H‑1B Holders Yet Face No Restrictions
paras: 美國副總統范斯（JD Vance）指控，微軟(MSFT-US) 2025年裁撤6,000名員工後，改以持H-1B工作簽證的外籍勞工填補職缺。不過，美國公民及移民服務局（USCIS）的簽證核准數據顯示，微軟去年獲准的H-1B簽證中，約三分之二是給已在公司任職的員工，並非新聘人員。
根據《CNBC》報導，川普政府週四（8日）宣布，暫停8家科技公司透過勞工部PERM計畫為外籍員工申請綠卡的資格。
這項措施暫停的是美國勞工部的PERM綠卡申請計畫，該計畫涉及協助移民取得永久居留權的程序，並不影響H-1B臨時工作簽證。
不過，H-1B簽證核准數據仍能反映這些企業對外籍勞工的依賴程度。
值得注意的是，根據美國公民及移民服務局的H-1B雇主數據中心，亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 與Meta(META-US) 是2025財政年度獲准H-1B簽證最多的兩家企業，分別取得19,178件及6,294件核准，但兩家公司均未被列入暫停名單。微軟則以6,258件緊追在後。
范斯在週四的記者會上表示，微軟2025年裁撤6,000名員工，卻大量聘用持H-1B簽證的外籍勞工。
他聲稱：「如果算一下，每裁掉一名員工，微軟就以1.5名外籍契約勞工取代他們。」不過，范斯同時強調，微軟是一家優秀的美國企業，雙方維持良好關係。
然而，報導指出，簽證數據顯示，儘管微軟去年確實取得超過6,000件H-1B簽證核准，但其中約三分之二的受益人原本就已在微軟工作。
相較之下，亞馬遜去年取得的H-1B核准數量約為微軟的3倍，且新聘的H-1B員工人數接近微軟的4倍，但亞馬遜卻並未被列入暫停名單。
此次遭暫停PERM計畫申請資格的8家企業，全都名列美國H-1B簽證核准數量前50大雇主，其中多數為資訊科技服務及顧問公司，Adobe(ADBE-US) 則排名第45，是名單中規模最小的企業。
從整體排名來看，亞馬遜與Meta的H-1B簽證核准數量均高於微軟，卻未遭到同樣處置。微軟過去多年一直是H-1B簽證的主要雇主，但亞馬遜在2017年超越微軟後，兩者的差距持續擴大。
川普政府此次整頓行動不僅針對科技業。勞工部監察長德艾斯波西托（Anthony D’Esposito）同日在記者會上宣布，將調查9所美國知名大學涉嫌涉及J-1簽證詐欺的案件。
川普的支持者長期主張，企業透過相關簽證計畫聘用外國人，可能削弱美國勞工的就業機會。
paras_en: U.S. Vice President JD Vance accused Microsoft (MSFT‑US) of replacing 6,000 jobs slated for elimination in 2025 with foreign workers on H‑1B visas. However, data from U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) shows that about two‑thirds of the H‑1B visas Microsoft received approval for last year were granted to employees already working at the company, not to new hires.

According to a CNBC report, the Trump administration announced on Thursday (the 8th) that it would suspend eight technology companies from using the Department of Labor’s PERM program to apply for green cards for foreign employees.
The suspension applies to the Department of Labor’s PERM green‑card application program, which assists immigrants in obtaining permanent residency, and does not affect the temporary H‑1B work visa.
Nevertheless, H‑1B approval data still reflects how much these firms rely on foreign labor.

Notably, USCIS’s H‑1B employer data center shows that Amazon (AMZN‑US) and Meta (META‑US) were the two companies with the most H‑1B approvals for fiscal year 2025, receiving 19,178 and 6,294 approvals respectively, and neither was placed on the suspension list. Microsoft followed closely with 6,258 approvals.
Vance said at Thursday’s press conference that Microsoft will cut 6,000 jobs in 2025 but will hire a large number of foreign workers on H‑1B visas.

He claimed, “If you do the math, Microsoft replaces each laid‑off employee with 1.5 foreign contract workers.” He also emphasized that Microsoft is a great American company and that relations remain good.

However, the report notes that visa data shows that although Microsoft did receive more than 6,000 H‑1B approvals last year, roughly two‑thirds of the beneficiaries were already employed by Microsoft.

In contrast, Amazon’s H‑1B approvals last year were about three times Microsoft’s, and the number of newly hired H‑1B employees was nearly four times Microsoft’s, yet Amazon was not placed on the suspension list.

All eight firms whose PERM applications were suspended are among the top 50 U.S. H‑1B employers, most of them information‑technology services and consulting firms; Adobe (ADBE‑US) ranks 45th and is the smallest company on the list.

Overall, Amazon and Meta have higher H‑1B approval counts than Microsoft but were not treated the same. Microsoft has long been a major H‑1B employer, but after Amazon overtook it in 2017, the gap has continued to widen.

The Trump administration’s crackdown is not limited to the tech sector. Department of Labor Inspector General Anthony D’Esposito announced at the same press conference that investigations will be launched into nine well‑known U.S. universities suspected of J‑1 visa fraud.
Trump supporters have long argued that companies hiring foreigners through these visa programs may diminish employment opportunities for American workers.

items.title: 2029告別「最不發達國家」！孟加拉告別關稅紅利積極轉型   力拚工業化擺脫成衣依賴
items.title_en: Bangladesh to Exit ‘Least Developed Country’ Status in 2029, Shifts from Garment Dependence to Industrialization
paras: 南亞國家孟加拉原定今年11月從聯合國「最不發達國家」名單「畢業」、轉為發展中國家，但聯合國發展政策委員會已接受其申請，把準備期延至2029年11月，市場更關注其後關稅優惠退場與產業升級能力。
隨著孟國總理塔里克·拉赫曼2月就職、結束前段政治動盪，國際投資人正重新評估這個南亞第二大經濟體的改革空間。
過去外資最詬病的是「跑印章」。有投資人稱，企業落地需往多個部門補文件，單一專案往往接觸六個以上審批環節。
但自今年8月20日起，孟國將投資發展局、經濟區管理局、公私合营管理局併入直屬總理辦公室的「投資孟加拉」(Invest Bangladesh)，目標是單一窗口、一站式辦證。
孟國國際與戰略研究所高級研究員阿希克(Mohammad Ashique Rahman)表示，外資進入後能否一次取得環境、用地、公司、稅務與勞工相關審批，是改革成敗關鍵；政府同時研究合併稅項、推進稅制簡化。
不過，業內人士也提醒，機構重組仍處過渡期，實際能效要看審批時程是否真正壓縮。
成衣(RMG)仍是孟國經濟晴雨表，佔出口八至九成。2025/26財年孟加拉總出口約480億美元、按年微降0.58%，其中成衣387億美元，低於550億總目標、成衣450億目標；7至4月成衣317.2億美元、年減2.82%，反映成本、競爭與歐美訂單放緩壓力。
官方還表示，部分財年統計的成衣淨收益年增約4.31%，企業保留外匯改善，但整體仍要靠多元化。
孟國央行設3000億塔卡出口多元化再融資，扶持皮革、黃麻、造船、輕工與ICT，對外已與日韓簽雙邊協定、推歐盟、紐西蘭、馬來西亞、阿聯談判，擬年內完成4至5個。
能源是隱患。中東戰事推高進口成本，先是今年3、4月燃油漲價，7、8月天然氣供應大減，發電、化肥與工廠受限。
IMF預估，孟國2026財年增長約4.7%、2027財年放緩至4.3%，通膨目標仍受挑戰。 改革若只停在招商簡化、未解電力與銀行不良貸款，投資落地仍會打折。
中資成為重要變量。塔里克6月訪中時簽訂「中國經濟產業園投資開發協議」，該園區佔地約314公頃、投資3億美元、特許50年，主打紡服、機械、電子資訊、生物醫藥與綠能，預計帶動10億美元投資、10萬崗位。
BEZA執行主席喬杜里表示，外資辦證由半年至一年壓至14天內。上海國關院南亞中心主任劉宗義認為，協議快速掃清歷史障礙，體現孟國工業化急迫性。
此外，Runner Automobiles董事會8月批准推進比亞迪本地生產，先以整車進口建經銷與售後，再轉本地組裝。訪孟中企普遍認為，孟國員工服從性高、制衣女工就業管道窄而珍惜崗位，但街頭無電動車、充電與關稅政策未明，量產仍需觀察。
分析人士指出，孟加拉從「政策招商」走向「系統營商」，單一窗口、成衣升級、中資園區與電動車試水若能同步，可緩解LDC畢業後關稅紅利消失的衝擊，但若能源、治安與部門協調跟不上，外資仍會停留在考察階段。
paras_en: Bangladesh, a South Asian nation, had originally planned to graduate from the UN’s ‘Least Developed Countries’ list in November this year and become a developing country, but the UN Development Policy Committee has accepted its request to postpone the transition until November 2029, prompting markets to focus on how the country will handle the loss of tariff preferences and its capacity for industrial upgrading.

With Prime Minister Tariq Rahman taking office in February and ending a period of political turbulence, international investors are re‑evaluating the reform potential of the region’s second‑largest economy.

In the past, foreign investors’ biggest complaint was the “stamp‑chasing” process. Some investors said that setting up a business required submitting documents to multiple agencies, with a single project often encountering more than six approval steps.

Since August 20 of this year, Bangladesh has merged its Investment Development Authority, Economic Zones Authority and Public‑Private Partnership Authority into the Prime Minister’s Office‑directed “Invest Bangladesh”, aiming for a one‑stop, single‑window service for approvals.

Mohammad Ashique Rahman, senior researcher at the Bangladesh Institute of International and Strategic Studies, said that whether foreign investors can obtain environmental, land, company, tax and labour approvals in one go is the key to the success of reforms; the government is also studying tax consolidation and simplification of the tax system.
However, industry insiders caution that the institutional restructuring is still in a transition phase, and the real efficiency gains will depend on whether approval timelines are truly compressed.

The ready‑made garment (RMG) sector remains the barometer of Bangladesh’s economy, accounting for 80‑90% of exports. In FY 2025/26 total exports are projected at about $48 billion, a slight annual decline of 0.58%, with garments at $38.7 billion, below the $55 billion overall target and the $45 billion garment target; from July to April, garment exports were $31.72 billion, down 2.82% year‑on‑year, reflecting cost pressures, competition and a slowdown in European and US orders.
Officials also noted that net garment earnings for the fiscal year grew about 4.31% year‑on‑year, allowing firms to retain foreign exchange, but overall diversification remains essential.

The central bank has set up a 300 billion‑taka export‑diversification refinancing facility to support leather, jute, shipbuilding, light industry and ICT, and has already signed bilateral agreements with Japan and South Korea while negotiating with the EU, New Zealand, Malaysia and the UAE, aiming to conclude four to five deals within the year.

Energy is a hidden risk. Conflict in the Middle East has pushed up import costs, first with fuel price spikes in March and April, then a sharp reduction in natural‑gas supply in July and August, constraining power generation, fertilizer production and factories.

The IMF projects Bangladesh’s FY 2026 growth at about 4.7% and a slowdown to 4.3% in FY 2027, with inflation targets still under pressure. If reforms stop at simplifying investment procedures without addressing power shortages and bad‑loan issues in banks, investment inflows will remain discounted.

Chinese investment is becoming a significant variable. During Prime Minister Tariq’s June visit to China, a “China Economic and Industrial Park Investment Development Agreement” was signed; the park will cover about 314 ha, involve $300 million of investment, enjoy a 50‑year lease, focus on textiles, machinery, electronics, biotech and green energy, and is expected to generate $1 billion in investment and 100,000 jobs.

BEZA Executive Chairman Jo Duri said that foreign‑investment approval times have been cut from six‑months‑to‑a‑year down to within 14 days. Liu Zongyi, director of the South Asia Center at Shanghai International Studies University, believes the agreement quickly clears historical obstacles and reflects Bangladesh’s urgency to industrialise.

In addition, Runner Automobiles’ board approved in August the push for local production of BYD vehicles, starting with full‑car imports for dealership and after‑sales service before moving to local assembly. Visiting Chinese firms generally find Bangladeshi workers highly compliant and garment‑worker jobs scarce and valued, but note the lack of electric‑vehicle charging infrastructure and unclear tariff policies, meaning mass production still needs observation.

Analysts point out that Bangladesh’s shift from “policy‑driven investment promotion” to a “systemic business environment”, together with a single‑window, garment upgrading, Chinese‑run parks and electric‑vehicle pilots, could mitigate the impact of losing LDC tariff benefits after graduation. However, if energy supply, security and inter‑agency coordination lag, foreign investment will likely remain at the scouting stage.

items.title: 俄羅斯鼠疫研究人員死亡原因依舊「不明」！WHO：未通報任何鼠疫病例
items.title_en: Cause of Death of Russian Plague Researcher Remains "Unclear"! WHO: No Plague Cases Reported
paras: 世界衛生組織（WHO）週六（10日）表示，目前仍不清楚本月導致俄羅斯西伯利亞一間反鼠疫研究中心的實驗室員工因肺炎死亡的原因，且當地尚未通報任何鼠疫病例。
根據《路透》報導，WHO表示，俄羅斯國家監管機構通報，針對該名實驗室員工及曾與她接觸者進行的高風險病原體檢測，結果均呈陰性。所有接觸者至今仍未出現症狀，當局也未發現其他與此事件相關的重症肺炎病例。
WHO在聲明中表示：「根據目前提供的資訊，WHO尚未發現證據顯示這起事件存在持續傳播的情況。仍有一項關鍵疑點尚待釐清，即該名死亡的實驗室員工尚未獲得確診。」
這名實驗室員工於10月2日發病並死亡，具體情況未對外公布。事件發生後，當局對約200人實施隔離，也引發社群媒體對公共衛生風險的擔憂。
自新冠疫情爆發以來，全球衛生官員對於病因不明的致命肺炎病例更加警覺。新冠疫情最初源於中國一群快速傳播的致命呼吸道疾病病例。不過，肺炎病例的確切病因往往無法查明。
俄羅斯當局表示，該名實驗室員工已依規定接種適當疫苗，且在其體內未發現與其工作相關的微生物。
俄羅斯週四（8日）表示，已完成對該名員工所有接觸者的健康檢查，並稱已依照既定程序向WHO提供完整資訊。
paras_en: The World Health Organization (WHO) said on Saturday (the 10th) that the cause of death of a laboratory employee at a anti‑plague research centre in Siberia, Russia, who died of pneumonia this month remains unclear, and that no plague cases have been reported locally.

According to Reuters, WHO said the Russian national regulator reported that high‑risk pathogen testing on the laboratory employee and her contacts all came back negative. All contacts remain asymptomatic to date, and authorities have not identified any other severe pneumonia cases linked to the incident.

In its statement, WHO said: "Based on the information currently available, WHO has found no evidence of ongoing transmission. A key question remains that the deceased laboratory employee has not been confirmed [with plague]."

The laboratory employee fell ill on October 2 and died, with specific details not disclosed publicly. After the incident, authorities placed about 200 people in isolation, prompting social‑media concerns about public‑health risk.

Since the COVID‑19 pandemic began, global health officials have become more vigilant about fatal pneumonia cases of unknown origin. The COVID‑19 pandemic originally emerged in China as a cluster of rapidly spreading, deadly respiratory disease cases. However, the exact cause of many pneumonia cases often cannot be determined.
Russian authorities said the laboratory employee had been vaccinated in accordance with regulations and that no work‑related microorganisms were found in her body.
Russia said on Thursday (the 8th) that it has completed health checks of all contacts of the employee and that it has provided WHO with complete information in line with established procedures.

items.title: 馬斯克放話Terrafab會做出「比誰都好的晶片」
items.title_en: Musk Says Terrafab Will Produce “Better Chips Than Anyone”
paras: 馬斯克表示，他認為旗下公司憑藉打造客製化設備的經驗，「很可能會找出方法，做出比任何人都好的晶片」。
馬斯克週六(10日)於德州奧斯汀特斯拉（Tesla）超級工廠外舉行的「X Takeover」活動中，透過線上直播向現場客戶與投資人坦言，雖然目前對微晶片製造「一無所知，但我們會找出辦法」。
他指出，在參訪競爭對手的廠房時，並未看到太多客製化設備，而旗下團隊在此領域累積了豐富經驗，足以優化製造流程。
「我想可以肯定地說，這是全世界最困難的事情之一，」馬斯克表示：「我並非自滿或自以為是，但說實話，我認為我們大概能找出比任何人都優異的晶片製造方式。我不知道這需要多久時間，可能需要好幾年。」
馬斯克正準備透過特斯拉(TSLA-US) 、SpaceX(SPCX-US) 與英特爾(INTC-US) 的合資企業，於德州格林姆斯（Grimes）興建一座名為「Terrafab」的晶片廠，初始投資金額超過150億美元。
該計畫預計創造3,000個工作機會，並獲得德州企業基金（Texas Enterprise Fund）補助3,000萬美元。
這座占地達1,000萬平方英呎的設施將分期興建，建案腹地約為3,000英畝，而 SpaceX 目前在當地掌控的土地更超過1.3萬英畝。
6 月上市的 SpaceX 近期股價重返每股 135 美元的首次公開發行（IPO）價格之上，讓馬斯克成為全球首位兆美元富豪。
該公司正接近與投資公司 Grain Management LLC 達成協議，取得所需頻譜，進而成為行動電信業者，與 T-Mobile、威訊（Verizon）及 AT&T 競爭。
特斯拉上週五公布聲明指出，第 3 季全球交車量達 486,532 輛，優於市場預期。彭博彙整的分析師預估，平均交車量為 463,761 輛。
在汽車銷量下滑、股價表現落後一段時間後，這項成績為特斯拉帶來利多。公司計畫今年投入超過 250 億美元擴建工廠營運並推動 Robotaxi 業務，並已取得 300 億美元的新貸款與信用額度，以支應成長。
paras_en: Musk said he believes his companies, leveraging experience in building custom equipment, are "very likely to find a way to make chips better than anyone else's."

Musk on Saturday (the 10th) at the Tesla Gigafactory in Austin, Texas, during an "X Takeover" event held outside the plant, told customers and investors via live stream that although they currently know "nothing" about microchip manufacturing, they will find a way.
He noted that when visiting competitors' factories, he did not see many custom machines, and his team's extensive experience in that field is enough to optimise the manufacturing process.

I think I can say with confidence that this is one of the hardest things in the world," Musk said. "I'm not being arrogant, but honestly I think we can probably discover a chip‑making method that outperforms anyone else's. I don't know how long it will take—maybe several years."

Musk is preparing to build a chip fab called "Terrafab" in Grimes, Texas, through a joint venture of Tesla (TSLA-US), SpaceX (SPCX-US) and Intel (INTC-US), with an initial investment of over $15 billion.
The project is expected to create 3,000 jobs and will receive a $30 million grant from the Texas Enterprise Fund.
The 10‑million‑square‑foot facility will be built in phases on a site of about 3,000 acres, while SpaceX already controls more than 13,000 acres in the area.
SpaceX, which went public in June, has recently seen its share price rise back above its IPO price of $135 per share, making Musk the world’s first trillion‑dollar billionaire.

The company is close to reaching an agreement with investment firm Grain Management LLC to acquire the necessary spectrum and become a mobile telecom operator, competing with T‑Mobile, Verizon and AT&T.
Tesla announced on Friday that third‑quarter global deliveries reached 486,532 vehicles, beating market expectations. Bloomberg’s consensus estimate was an average of 463,761 deliveries.

After a period of declining auto sales and lagging stock performance, this result is a tailwind for Tesla. The company plans to invest more than $25 billion this year to expand factory operations and launch its Robotaxi business, and has secured a new $30 billion loan and credit facility to fund growth.

items.title: 川普表態：烏克蘭該換總統了 澤倫斯基成俄烏和平協議阻礙
items.title_en: Trump Says Ukraine Needs a New President, Zelensky Is an Obstacle to a Russia‑Ukraine Peace Deal
paras: 美國總統川普周六（10日）表示，烏克蘭該換一位新總統了，烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基已成為俄烏達成和平協議的障礙，且美國柴油價格高漲也與澤倫斯基有關。
川普當天在啟程前往田納西州準備參加一場共和黨選民集會前表達了他對澤倫斯基的看法，他說：「我建議烏克蘭換一位能夠達成和平協議的元首，他本來有機會達成很多協議，但不知出於什麼原因，他始終沒這麼做。」
川普指出：「我國說過，烏克蘭可以隨意對付俄羅斯，但不要攻擊煉油廠，因為那是世界性問題。澤倫斯基想給全世界製造麻煩，他想給我國農民、牧場主製造麻煩，讓他們因柴油而陷入困境。」
澤倫斯基此前無視美國六次停止攻擊俄羅斯煉油廠的要求，川普對此極為惱火。
此前一天，川普與俄羅斯總統普丁達成一項柴油供應協議，試圖緩解燃油價格高漲態勢，為即將到來的美國期中選舉做準備。
俄羅斯將立即向美國及全球市場供應超過30萬噸柴油，11月供應50萬噸，此後再供應100萬噸。川普表示，俄羅斯將視煉油廠運行狀況短期內再額外供應300萬噸柴油。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Saturday (the 10th) that Ukraine should get a new president, claiming that President Volodymyr Zelensky has become an obstacle to a Russia‑Ukraine peace agreement and that soaring U.S. diesel prices are also linked to Zelensky.

Trump voiced his view of Zelensky just before departing for Tennessee to attend a Republican voter rally, saying, "I suggest Ukraine replace its leader with someone who can achieve a peace deal. He had the chance to strike many agreements, but for some reason he never did."

Trump added, "We've said Ukraine can deal with Russia as it wishes, but it must not attack refineries because that's a global issue. Zelensky wants to cause trouble worldwide; he wants to trouble our farmers and ranchers, putting them in a bind over diesel."
Zelensky had previously ignored six U.S. requests to stop striking Russian oil refineries, which greatly angered Trump.
The day before, Trump struck a diesel‑supply deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin aimed at easing rising fuel prices ahead of the upcoming U.S. midterm elections.

Russia will immediately supply more than 300,000 tonnes of diesel to the U.S. and global markets, 500,000 tonnes in November, and later another 1 million tonnes, with Trump saying Russia may add an extra 3 million tonnes in the short term depending on refinery operations.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元連四周上漲 油價走高壓抑歐元連五周走貶
items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Rises for Fourth Consecutive Week as Oil Prices Climb, Suppressing Euro’s Five‑Week Decline
paras: 美元周五(9日)上漲，歐元則連續第五周下跌。隨著油價回升、抹去稍早跌幅，歐元早盤漲勢逐漸消退。不過，由於法國陷入困境的公債市場趨於穩定，歐元近期的賣壓有所緩和。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.13%，報102.25。美元指數本周上漲約0.3%，連續第四周走高，寫下2025年5月以來最長連漲紀錄。
本周一，歐元兌美元一度跌至1.1161美元，創17個月新低。投資人憂心法國公共債務創下歷史新高，且政府削減預算支出的政治之路困難重重。相較之下，美國經濟與美元則顯得相對強勁。
歐元兌美元下跌0.1%，至1.1198美元，本周累計下跌約0.5%，創下2025年初以來兌美元連續周線下跌最長紀錄。
法國與義大利公債的風險溢價本周有望下滑。這些溢價在9月下旬曾大幅攀升，但隨著投資人等待新的局勢發展，再決定是否要求更高的報酬，以補償財政與政治風險，近期風險溢價已逐步回落。
川普暗示不會攻擊伊朗
周五稍早，全球債券市場趨於平靜。美國總統川普表示，美國不會在11月3日美國期中選舉前攻擊伊朗，並稱美國與德黑蘭當局就戰事進行了富有成果的談判。受此消息影響，油價稍早下跌。
Moneycorp交易與結構型產品主管Eugene Epstein表示，「目前有多項因素同時發揮影響，包括油價走高，以及法國的問題，因此很難判斷究竟是哪一項因素對市場的影響更大。」
「但實際來看，我認為今天市場相對處於觀望狀態。所有人都在等待聯準會(Fed)官員的談話陸續釋出，因為現在可以明顯看出，美元對各位聯準會官員的談話都相當敏感。」
然而，隨著英國海軍相關機構英國海事貿易行動辦公室(UKMTO)表示，一艘船隻在阿拉伯聯合大公國半島以西13海浬處遭不明飛行物擊中，原油價格隨後自低點反彈。
美國原油上漲0.6%，報每桶92.04美元，盤中最低曾跌至90.01美元。布蘭特原油則上漲0.58%，報每桶104.88美元，稍早最低曾跌至102.33美元。
全球各地債券殖利率近幾周持續攀升，原因包括市場預期各國央行將升息，以及對政府財政狀況的憂慮。
央行政策成焦點
儘管近期經濟數據顯示通膨壓力持續存在，市場對聯準會本月稍晚政策會議升息的預期仍相對有限。

儘管多位聯準會官員表示，為了抑制通膨，未來仍有必要進一步升息，但也有官員反對立即升息，並指出聯準會應保持耐心與彈性，再決定未來的利率走向。
法國公債持續承壓，政界人士難以在2027年一場充滿分歧的選舉前有效削減預算赤字。本周稍早，西班牙宣布提前舉行大選，也進一步增加歐元的壓力。

paras_en: The dollar rose on Friday (the 9th), while the euro fell for a fifth straight week. As oil prices recovered, erasing earlier losses, the euro’s early‑session gains gradually faded. However, with France’s troubled sovereign‑bond market stabilising, selling pressure on the euro has eased somewhat recently.

In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.13% to 102.25. The index is up about 0.3% this week, marking a fourth consecutive week of gains and the longest winning streak since May 2025.

On Monday, the euro slipped to $1.1161, a 17‑month low. Investors worry that France’s public debt has hit a historic high and that the political path to cutting budget spending is fraught with difficulty. By contrast, the U.S. economy and the dollar appear relatively strong.
The euro fell 0.1% to $1.1198, down about 0.5% for the week, setting the longest run of weekly declines against the dollar since early 2025.

Risk premiums on French and Italian sovereign bonds are expected to fall this week. Those premiums surged in late September, but as investors await new developments and decide whether higher compensation is needed for fiscal and political risk, the premiums have been gradually retreating.
Trump hints he will not attack Iran

Earlier on Friday, global bond markets steadied. U.S. President Donald Trump said the United States will not attack Iran before the November 3 mid‑term elections and claimed that the U.S. and Tehran had productive war‑related talks. The news knocked oil prices lower earlier in the session.

Eugene Epstein, head of transactions and structured products at Moneycorp, said, “There are several factors at play right now, including rising oil prices and France’s issues, so it’s hard to pinpoint which factor is having the bigger market impact.”

“In reality, I think the market is in a wait‑and‑see mode today. Everyone is waiting for Fed officials’ remarks to roll out, because it’s clear the dollar is very sensitive to whatever the Fed speakers say,” he added.

However, the UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) reported that a vessel 13 nautical miles west of the UAE peninsula was struck by an unidentified flying object, after which crude oil prices rebounded from their lows.
U.S. crude rose 0.6% to $92.04 a barrel, after dipping to a intraday low of $90.01. Brent crude gained 0.58% to $104.88, after an earlier low of $102.33.
Bond yields around the world have been climbing for several weeks, driven by expectations of rate hikes by central banks and concerns over sovereign fiscal health.
Central‑bank policy is in focus
Even though recent economic data show persistent inflation pressure, market expectations for a rate hike at this month’s Fed policy meeting remain relatively modest.

According to the CME FedWatch tool, the market currently assigns a 19.4% probability that the Fed will raise rates by at least one basis point this month, while the odds of a hike at the December meeting are as high as 85.8%.

A Michigan University consumer survey released on Friday showed that, as Middle‑East conflict pushes up living costs, U.S. consumer confidence slipped further in early October and households grew more pessimistic about the economic outlook.

While several Fed officials have said further rate hikes may be needed to curb inflation, some have opposed an immediate increase, arguing the Fed should stay patient and flexible before deciding the future rate path.

French sovereign bonds remain under pressure, and politicians find it hard to meaningfully cut the budget deficit before a divisive 2027 election. Earlier this week, Spain announced an early election, adding further pressure on the euro.
The pound rose 0.08% to $1.3235 against the dollar but has been falling for a seventh consecutive week, the longest streak of declines since November 2024.
The dollar gained 0.25% against the yen to ¥158.25. The yen may be on track for a fourth straight week of weakness, down about 0.2% for the week.

items.title: 資金急找避風港！全球貨幣市場基金吸金1538億美元 美股基金轉失血
items.title_en: Funds Scramble for Safe Havens! Global Money‑Market Funds Pull in $153.81 Billion, US Equity Funds Turn Red
paras: 全球債市賣壓加劇，美債殖利率攀高與油價居高不下，加深投資人對通膨的疑慮，促使資金轉向避險。根據LSEG Lipper數據，截至10月7日當周，全球貨幣市場基金淨流入1,538.1億美元，創5月6日當周以來最多；美國股票基金則終止連兩周吸金，遭撤資51.1億美元。
標普500指數本周稍早觸及7,844.52點歷史新高，隨後回落。通膨疑慮引發債市拋售，美國10年期公債殖利率攀抵5.3645%，創2002年4月以來新高，壓抑市場情緒，也促使投資人在股市上漲之際獲利了結。
歐洲債務問題同樣牽動市場。法國預算赤字占國內生產毛額(GDP)比重超過5%，加上明年總統大選恐加劇政治分歧，推升其10年期公債殖利率至4.994%，創24年新高。
全球股票基金當周僅淨流入5.6億美元，為近三周最少。歐洲與亞洲股票基金分別吸金61.9億及61.6億美元，美國則出現9月16日當周以來首次淨流出。其中，美國大型、中型及小型股基金分別失血140.8億、10.3億及8.34億美元。
不過，資金並未全面撤離美股。美國產業型基金仍吸金56.8億美元，以科技類股的45.3億美元居首，公用事業與工業類股也分別吸金11.8億及10.4億美元。
債券基金也持續獲資金青睞。全球債券基金淨流入260.3億美元，創7月8日當周以來最多；其中，美國債券基金吸金197.8億美元，創單周紀錄。美國短中期政府債券與公債基金吸金67.6億美元，為六個月最多，短中期投資等級債券基金另吸金50.4億美元。
美國貨幣市場基金則淨流入684.9億美元，扭轉前一周淨流出436億美元的情況。此外，全球黃金及其他貴金屬基金連續第四周吸金，當周流入14.1億美元。新興市場債券基金吸金14.8億美元，股票基金則連續第五周失血，淨流出7.52億美元。
paras_en: Global bond‑market selling pressure intensified, with U.S. Treasury yields climbing and oil prices staying high, deepening investors' inflation concerns and prompting a shift toward safe‑haven assets. According to LSEG Lipper data, in the week to October 7 the net inflow into global money‑market funds was $153.81 billion, the largest since the week of May 6; U.S. equity funds, meanwhile, ended a two‑week inflow streak with a net outflow of $5.11 billion.

The S&P 500 touched a record high of 7,844.52 points earlier this week before pulling back. Inflation worries sparked a bond‑market sell‑off, pushing the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield to 5.3645%—a peak not seen since April 2002—dampening market sentiment and prompting investors to take profits as equities rose.

Europe's debt issues also weighed on markets. France’s budget deficit exceeds 5% of GDP, and the upcoming presidential election next year could heighten political divisions, lifting its 10‑year sovereign yield to 4.994%, a 24‑year high.

Global equity funds recorded a net inflow of only $560 million for the week, the lowest in nearly three weeks. European and Asian equity funds attracted $6.19 billion and $6.16 billion respectively, while the U.S. saw its first weekly net outflow since the week of September 16. U.S. large‑cap, mid‑cap and small‑cap equity funds lost $14.08 billion, $1.03 billion and $834 million respectively.

Nevertheless, money has not fled U.S. equities entirely. U.S. sector funds still drew $5.68 billion, led by technology funds with $4.53 billion, while utilities and industrials attracted $1.18 billion and $1.04 billion respectively.

Bond funds continued to enjoy inflows. Global bond funds saw a net inflow of $26.03 billion, the highest since the week of July 8; U.S. bond funds alone attracted $19.78 billion, a single‑week record. U.S. short‑ and intermediate‑term government and sovereign bond funds pulled in $6.76 billion, the most in six months, and short‑ and intermediate‑term investment‑grade bond funds added another $5.04 billion.

U.S. money‑market funds recorded a net inflow of $68.49 billion, reversing the previous week’s outflow of $43.6 billion. Meanwhile, global gold and other precious‑metal funds logged a fourth consecutive week of inflows, bringing in $1.41 billion. Emerging‑market bond funds attracted $1.48 billion, while equity funds suffered a fifth straight week of outflows, netting a $752 million withdrawal.

items.title: 史上最大重組月底上路！683家日企逐步從東證指數剔除  逾1兆美元被動資金面臨調整
items.title_en: Largest Reorganization in History Set for End of Month! 683 Japanese Companies Gradually Removed from TOPIX, Over $1 Trillion in Passive Funds Face Adjustments
paras: 日本交易所集團(JPX)周三(7日)公布東證股價指數(Topix)史上最大規模成分股重組，10月30日起生效。按新流動性與自由流通市值標準，683檔現有股票不符納入條件、35檔來自標準市場與成長市場的新股納入。若執行順利，Topix成分股將由8月底約1636檔、兩年內降至約986檔，較現有股數接近腰斬。
這是Topix改革第二階段。第一階段2025年1月已把成分股由約2200檔壓至約1700檔，此次進一步把「上市市場」篩選邏輯改為「交易活躍度＋自由流通市值」，現有公司須滿足年度換手率等流動性要求，並進入自由流通市值前97%。新納入者須進前96%。
未達上述標準者不會即日出局，指數權重按季遞減，至2028年7月降至零，若明年10月重評重新達標可中止減權，2028年10月起改為年度再平衡。
與此同時，被動資金規模使改革備受全球關注。大和證券首席量化橋本淳一上月預估，約166兆日元(1.1兆美元)追蹤Topix。另據瑞銀預估，約155兆日元(1兆美元)，JPX統計則約160兆日元。
被列入剔除名單者面臨指數基金分期減持，新納入如日本麥當勞、東映動畫、叫車平台GO等可獲被動買盤與主動基金關注，但瑞銀日股分析師小林千紗指出，被剔除公司佔家數約三分之一，但佔Topix總市值不到3%，對指數表現與整體流動性的直接衝擊有限，主要影響是个股層面而非大盤方向。
JPX改革目的在提升可投資性與逼出公司治理。近年，JPX社長山道裕己持續推資本效率、股東回報與披露標準；Amundi Japan股票投資主管石原博美認為，成分股縮減「基本正面」，企業須持續證明留指數合理性，若分紅、回購、ROE改善逐案累積，可抬升日股整體評價。部分小型股已提前增加股東回報來降低剔出風險，但主動基金仍要分辨「為保指數而派息」與「真改善治理」的差別。
結構上，JPX新規更重視自由流通市值，有利三菱日聯、豐田、軟銀等大型藍籌股。
高盛分析師Bruce Kirk認為，AI相關大型股指數影響力會再升，東海東京分析師三道翔太則稱小型股剔出風險持續、大盤趨勢可能加強。
短期看，被剔小股有被動賣壓與流動性折價，新納入股有建倉支撐；中長期看，Topix從「廣泛涵蓋全市場」轉向「流動性優先的核心池」，可投資度提升，但也會犧牲小型股、低成交公司的價格發現功能。對追蹤Topix的ETF與退休基金而言，未來兩年再平衡節奏比單日調整更關鍵。
paras_en: Japan Exchange Group (JPX) announced on Wednesday (the 7th) the biggest ever component reshuffle of the TOPIX index, effective October 30. Under the new liquidity and free‑float market‑cap criteria, 683 existing stocks fail the inclusion rules while 35 new stocks from the Standard and Growth markets will be added. If implemented smoothly, TOPIX constituents will drop from about 1,636 at the end of August to roughly 986 within two years, nearly halving the current count.

This is the second phase of the TOPIX reform. The first phase, completed in January 2025, reduced the number of constituents from roughly 2,200 to about 1,700. The current phase changes the "listing market" screening logic to "trading activity + free‑float market cap"; existing companies must meet annual turnover‑rate liquidity requirements and rank within the top 97% of free‑float market cap, while newcomers must rank within the top 96%.

Companies that do not meet the new standards will not be removed immediately; their index weight will be phased down quarterly, reaching zero by July 2028. If they regain compliance in the October review next year, the weight reduction can be halted, and from October 2028 the index will be rebalanced annually.

At the same time, the massive scale of passive capital has drawn global attention to the reform. Daiwa Securities’ chief quant Junichi Hashimoto estimated last month that about ¥166 trillion (US$1.1 trillion) tracks TOPIX. UBS estimates around ¥155 trillion (US$1 trillion), while JPX’s own data put the figure at roughly ¥160 trillion.

Those placed on the removal list will face staged sell‑downs by index funds. New entrants such as McDonald’s Japan, Toei Animation and ride‑hailing platform GO can attract passive buying and active‑fund interest, but UBS Japan‑equity analyst Chisa Kobayashi notes that the companies slated for removal represent about one‑third of the number of constituents yet account for less than 3% of TOPIX’s total market value, so the direct impact on index performance and overall liquidity is limited, affecting mainly individual stocks rather than the market direction.

JPX’s reform aims to improve investability and push better corporate governance. In recent years, JPX President Hiroki Yamaguchi has promoted capital efficiency, shareholder returns and disclosure standards; Amundi Japan equity head Hiromi Ishihara sees the reduction of constituents as "basically positive," arguing that companies will need to continuously prove their relevance to the index, and that incremental improvements in dividends, buybacks and ROE can lift the overall valuation of Japanese equities. Some small‑cap stocks have already increased shareholder returns to lower their exclusion risk, but active managers must still differentiate between "dividends paid just to stay in the index" and genuine governance improvements.
Structurally, the new JPX rules place greater emphasis on free‑float market cap, benefiting large blue‑chip stocks such as Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, Toyota and SoftBank.

Goldman Sachs analyst Bruce Kirk believes AI‑related large‑cap stocks will gain even more influence in the index, while Tokai Tokyo analyst Shota Sando says the risk of small‑cap removals persists and could reinforce broader market trends.

In the short term, the removed small caps may face passive selling pressure and liquidity discounts, while the newly added stocks could receive buying support. Over the medium to long term, TOPIX will shift from a "broad market‑covering" index to a "liquidity‑first core pool," enhancing investability but sacrificing price‑discovery for small‑cap and low‑turnover stocks. For TOPIX‑tracking ETFs and pension funds, the rebalancing cadence over the next two years will be more critical than any single‑day adjustment.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走弱 歐洲公債殖利率自高點回落
items.title_en: <NY Forex> Dollar Weakens, European Government Bond Yields Retreat from Peaks
paras: 美元周四(8日)走弱，歐元區公債殖利率的升勢暫歇，而市場對聯準會(Fed)今年利率走向的預期大致維持不變。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.08%，報102.17，此前一度升至102.46。
歐元兌美元上漲0.08%，至1.1204美元，盤中一度跌至1.1171美元。
歐元區政府公債殖利率再度大幅上升，油價飆漲加劇通膨疑慮，投資人持續拋售法國、義大利等高負債國家的公債。
不過，隨著殖利率升勢逐漸降溫，歐元也從盤中低點回升。法國10年期公債殖利率上升2.7個基點至4.8873%，盤中一度攀升至4.9685%。
在投資人密切檢視法國的債務規模、預算赤字，以及2027年總統大選前的政治前景之際，法國受到的衝擊尤其明顯。
西班牙方面，工會周三宣布將於11月11日發動全國性總罷工，抗議住宅問題，而這場示威距離提前舉行的大選僅剩數周。
Fed釋放升息謹慎訊號
市場對聯準會本月稍晚政策會議升息的預期仍偏低。聯準會周三公布最新一次會議紀要後，顯示決策官員認為通膨是經濟展望面臨的最大風險，分析師則表示，會議紀要並未帶來意外訊號。
聯準會理事華勒(Christopher Waller)周四表示，為了讓通膨降至聯準會2%的目標，未來可能仍需要進一步升息，但他也表示升息步調具「彈性」，並為即將舉行的10月會議暫停升息留下空間。
華勒的言論呼應了部分聯準會官員上周的說法，他們均釋放出希望在進一步升息上保持耐心的訊號。
SimCorp多資產投資決策研究主管Christoph Schon表示，「多數其他貨幣似乎都與其貨幣政策預期呈反向關係，但那是因為過去一切都受到美元和聯準會主導，而這種情況在過去幾周仍持續存在。」
「有趣的是，現在還有另一個影響歐元的因素，也就是法國、如今甚至西班牙的政治危機……因此，這是一段短暫的時期，焦點不在利率差或貨幣政策，而是一場非常特殊的歐元危機，而在這個案例中，它正影響歐元。」
市場押注12月升息
根據CME FedWatch工具，市場目前預期聯準會本月升息至少25個基點的機率僅17.2%，略低於一周前的24.4%。不過，投資人押注12月會議升息的機率則達到81.2%。
在華勒發表上述評論後，高盛分析師在報告中表示，他們仍預期聯準會12月將再升息25個基點，並下調12月不升息的機率，因為華勒的言論代表政策立場轉向更加鷹派。
在更為鷹派的談話中，聖路易聯準銀行總裁穆薩林(Alberto Musalem)表示，美國央行需要再次升息，才能讓通膨回到2%的目標。
經濟數據方面，美國勞工部表示，上周初領失業金人數減少2,000人至19.7萬人，略低於《路透社》調查經濟學家預估的20萬人。最新數據持續顯示美國就業市場保持穩定。

paras_en: The dollar weakened on Thursday (the 8th), pausing the rise in Eurozone government bond yields, while market expectations for the Fed's rate path this year remained largely unchanged.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, fell 0.08% to 102.17 after briefly climbing to 102.46.
The euro rose 0.08% against the dollar to $1.1204, after dipping intraday to $1.1171.
Eurozone sovereign yields surged again as oil price spikes heightened inflation concerns, prompting investors to continue selling bonds of heavily indebted countries such as France and Italy.
However, as the yield rally cooled, the euro recovered from its intraday low. France's 10‑year yield rose 2.7 basis points to 4.8873%, briefly reaching 4.9685% during the session.
The impact on France was especially pronounced as investors closely examined its debt size, budget deficit, and political outlook ahead of the 2027 presidential election.
In Spain, unions announced on Wednesday a nationwide general strike on November 11 to protest housing issues, a protest taking place only weeks before an early election.
Fed signals cautious rate‑hike stance

Market expectations for a rate hike at the Fed's later policy meeting this month remain low. After the Fed released minutes of its latest meeting on Wednesday, officials said inflation remains the biggest risk to the economic outlook, and analysts said the minutes offered no surprise signals.

Fed Governor Christopher Waller said on Thursday that further rate hikes may still be needed to bring inflation down to the Fed's 2% target, but he also noted that the pace of hikes is “flexible,” leaving room to pause at the upcoming October meeting.
Waller's comments echoed remarks from other Fed officials last week, who all signaled a desire to be patient on any further tightening.

Christoph Schon, head of multi‑asset investment decision research at SimCorp, said, “Most other currencies seem to move opposite to their monetary‑policy expectations, but that’s because everything has been dominated by the dollar and the Fed, and that situation has persisted over the past few weeks.”

“Interestingly, there is now another factor affecting the euro – the political crises in France and now even Spain… So this is a short‑term episode where the focus is not on rate differentials or policy, but on a very specific euro crisis that is currently influencing the currency,” he added.
Markets bet on a December hike

According to the CME FedWatch tool, the market currently assigns a 17.2% probability that the Fed will raise rates by at least 25 basis points this month, down slightly from 24.4% a week ago. However, investors see an 81.2% chance of a hike at the December meeting.

After Waller’s remarks, a Goldman Sachs analyst wrote that they still expect a 25‑basis‑point hike in December and lowered the probability of no hike, interpreting Waller’s comments as a shift toward a more hawkish stance.
In an even more hawkish tone, Alberto Musalem, president of St. Louis Federal Reserve Bank, said the U.S. central bank needs another rate increase to bring inflation back to the 2% target.

On the data front, the U.S. Labor Department reported that initial unemployment claims fell by 2,000 to 197,000 last week, slightly below the Reuters poll forecast of 200,000, indicating the labor market remains stable.

Eurozone inflation may be higher than already elevated forecasts, but ECB policymakers have dampened market bets on a near‑term hike, with several officials on Thursday noting that, based on fundamentals, the situation is actually fairly moderate.
The widening yield gap between German bonds and those of high‑debt Eurozone members such as France and Italy has pushed the euro down to its lowest level since May 2024.

The pound rose 0.07% to $1.3219 after Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey said that as global bond markets face high borrowing and rising inflation pressures, governments need to work harder to demonstrate fiscal repair capability.

The dollar fell 0.12% to ¥157.88. The Bank of Japan said rising raw‑material costs are feeding price increases into consumer goods, with some firms raising prices more frequently, showing the BOJ’s concern over expanding inflation pressures.

外匯市場參與者周三關注聯準會9月貨幣政策會議紀要。紀要顯示，多數聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)官員認為，今年年底前還可能再升息一次。

會議紀要指出，「關於本次會議之後的貨幣政策前景，多數與會者認為，在今年年底前進一步上調聯邦資金利率目標區間可能是適當的。」
紀要也顯示，所有FOMC官員都支持9月升息。

法國政府上周公布2027年預算案，目標透過削減540億歐元的支出，將財政赤字目標控制在GDP的5%。
